products.title: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Khamrah Eau De Parfum is a warm, spicy, and irresistibly sweet unisex fragrance that is an oriental charm with a modern twist. Known for its rich cinnamon and vanilla profile, Khamrah is a bold scent inspired by Arabian traditions and global luxury tastes. Often compared to high-end niche perfumes, Lattafa Khamrah offers an affordable alternative without compromising on quality or performance. This perfume is ideal for people who enjoy strong, lasting fragrances with a warm, dessert-like aroma.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kaaf Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Kaaf Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2022 by the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house as a fresh aquatic fragrance with a floral and fruity composition and a musky drydown. It has the top notes of red fruits, watermelon, lavender and Sicilian orange; a heart of sweet floral bouquet of lotus, jasmine, and lily of the valley; and a musky base with warm sandalwood and Ambroxan

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Vulcan Feu Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and somewhat spicy perfume that suits both the women and men. It starts with an appetising blend of mango and lemon that is refreshing and cheerful, and it is spiced a little by ginger. Tones become light and sweet as it subsides with floral notes of praline such as jasmine and violet. Tonka bean, woods and moss make the base warm and smooth and thus comfortable and lasting. This smell is contemporary, comfortable, and very satisfying.

products.title: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Eclaire Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and comforting perfume that wraps you in a soft, cozy scent. Perfume for women, this scent feels like a warm dessert in a bottle. The aroma starts with the notes of caramel, milk and sugar, which create a smooth and creamy first impression. Then it changes to a floral and golden scent with honey and white flowers while the base floats away into vanilla, praline and musk.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Y Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is a fresh, modern, and confident fragrance that balances crisp freshness with deep woody notes. Inspired by the spirit of the contemporary man who dares to dream, this scent embodies boldness, freedom, and a touch of class.

The opening is refreshing, featuring juicy apple, spicy ginger, and zesty bergamot. In the heart, Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men brings aromatic sage, vibrant geranium, and juniper berries, giving it a green yet slightly floral twist. The base notes wrap you in warm amberwood, smooth tonka bean, rich cedar, vetiver, and olibanum, creating a long-lasting masculine trail.

Y Eau de Parfum Yves Saint Laurent for Men is perfect for those who love versatile, everyday scents with a signature edge. One spray is enough to make you feel fresh, stylish, and ready to conquer your day.

products.title: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Yara Candy Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fun and playful perfume made for women who love soft, fruity scents with a candy twist. The opening provides a delightful blend of black currant and green tangerine, which is a very juicy one. A pop of sweet strawberry fizz combined with a pale floral gardenia note resides in the heart. The final stage of the perfume is warm and creamy, with notes of vanilla, musk, amber, and sandalwood.

products.title: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Tam Dao Eau De Parfum is a calm, woody, and comforting unisex fragrance that brings to mind the peaceful beauty of sandalwood forests. Inspired by the mountains of Tonkin in Vietnam, this perfume is a tribute to sacred woods and age-old traditions. Tam Dao is simple yet rich, perfect for those who love warm, woody, and smooth scents with a soft floral base. Tam Dao is ideal for people who prefer minimalism in scent – smooth, clean, and soothing.

products.title: Lattafa Victoria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Victoria Eau de Parfum is a sweet and soft floral-fruity unisex scent that feels warm, cozy and a bit yummy. It opens with a bright and creamy smell of lemon meringue pie, moves into a soft neroli heart and dries down into a sweet vanilla base.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Eau De Parfum is an impressive, smooth, and elegant leather fragrance which has a rich and profound character. It starts with the spicy touch of cardamom, which is at once fresh and a little warm. In no time, strong leather notes along with soft jasmine give a powerful yet clean impression. Deep and long-lasting scent is achieved by the combination of amber, moss, and patchouli at the base. The fragrance strikes as being steadfast, contemporary, and fashionably, ideal for those who appreciate powerful and elegant scents.

products.title: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Jasoor Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume that gives a bold and confident vibe. Launched in 2023 by the house of Lattafa, it brings a fresh and spicy mix that feels both clean and deep. The perfume opens with juicy apple, spicy cardamom and fresh bergamot. The middle notes brings in warm tobacco, lavender and floral geranium. The dry-down is rich with tonka bean, leather, vetiver and patchouli.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Eau De Parfum is a strong and sweet scent for men that gives a feeling of luxury and elegance. The spicy opening with cumin and cardamom is rich and a bit refreshing at the same time. Little by little, the gentle rose and powdery orris appear and smoothen out the fragrance. Finally, vanilla, amber, and woods create a soft and very persistent end. This perfume is strong, masculine, and an ideal choice for the self-assured man.

products.title: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Rose De Soleil Eau de Parfum is a sweet, floral and fruity women’s perfume for those who like soft yet noticeable scents. It opens with juicy, fruity notes like peach, red mandarin and nectar, giving a fresh, sweet feel. The middle notes bring floral charm with jasmine, white flowers and creamy vanilla sugar. In the base, maple, syrup, amber and precious woods mix to create a warm sugary finish.

products.title: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Her Confession Eau de Parfum is a new and charming perfume for women launched in 2024 by Lattafa. It is a warm, feminine scent that blends floral, sweet and musky notes beautifully. The perfume starts with a fiery touch of Mystikal and Cinnamon, then goes to a soft floral heart composed of Tuberose, Jasmine, Incense, and Mahonial. The perfume takes a smooth fall into a base of Vanilla, Musk, and Tonka thereby developing a creamy and cozy finish that is both elegant and modern at the same time.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Silver Shade Eau De Parfum is a fresh, modern, and energetic unisex fragrance that feels like a cool mountain breeze in a bottle. This scent is designed for the stylish individual who loves a clean and uplifting aroma. It beautifully balances zesty citrus fruits with soft florals and a clean, musky base, creating a perfectly refreshing and sophisticated experience.

Silver Shade smells yet smooth, with a touch of class that makes it incredibly versatile. It’s the perfect choice for anyone who wants a signature scent that is easy to wear daily but still makes a statement. A spray of Ajmal Silver Shade will leave you feeling confident, fresh, and ready to conquer your day with effortless style.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is an elegant oriental fragrance for both men and women. Inspired by rich Arabic traditions and royal gatherings, this scent wraps you in warmth, sweetness, and a soft floral touch.

Bin Shaikh combines the beauty of fresh roses, exotic saffron, and earthy oak moss with a sweet heart of bakhoor, sugar, jasmine, and violet. The dry down is deep and comforting with oud, amber, ambroxan, musk, and patchouli creating a luxurious trail.

Ahmed Al Maghribi Bin Shaikh Eau de Parfum is perfect for those who love sweet, woody scents with a hint of floral freshness. Just a few sprays make you feel confident, royal, and ready for any special moment.

products.title: Calvin Klein Ck One Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein CK One Eau de Toilette is one of the most famous unisex perfume in the world which was launched in 1994 it brings a fresh and clean vibe that feels natural on both men and women. The Fragrance starts with citrus fruits like lemon, bergamot and mandarin orange, mixed with pineapple, green notes, cardamom and papaya and the middle brings a soft floral touch with jasmine, violet, rose, freesia, lily of the valley, nutmeg and orris root. The base is warm and balanced with green tea, sandalwood, musk, cedar, oakmoss, amber and green accords. CK One is simple, cool and made for everyday wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Eau De Parfum is a classy and modern women’s fragrance that feels fresh, soft, and slightly sweet. It opens with a clean lavender and juicy orange feel that smells bright and confident. Slowly, white flowers like orange blossom and jasmine come out and feel smooth and feminine. The vanilla and musk base makes it warm and long lasting. This scent feels elegant, bold, and perfect for confident women.

products.title: Lattafa Atheeri Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Atheeri Lattafa Perfumes is a floral oriental perfume for women. This is a new fragrance. Atheeri was launched in 2025. Passion Flower and Dew Drop are the highest notes; Orchid and Jasmine are the middle notes; Vanilla and Amberwood are the lowest notes. The first impression is light and fresh with a touch of water and a flowery fragrance, but gradually, it becomes warm and smooth in the heart. The base has vanilla and amberwood that provide a warm, though slightly sweet taste that lingers for hours later. It suits well those female customers who prefer floral perfumes with a soft, warm touch.

products.title: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Armaf Club de Nuit Intense Man Eau de Toilette is one of the most talked-about scents in the men’s fragrance world which was released in 2015 it has a sharp, fresh and bold profile that combines fruity, floral and woody notes in one bottle. The perfume starts with a blast of lemon, pineapple, bergamot, black currant and apple giving a citrusy yet sweet start. The middle slowly brings in smoky birch, soft jasmine and gentle rose. The endnotes are smooth and long-lasting with musk, ambergris, patchouli and a touch of vanilla which adds warmth and depth.

products.title: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Rare Carbon Eau de Parfum is a bold leather perfume for men launched in 2020 by the house of Afnan Perfumes. It carries a strong masculine edge with an elegant combination of spicy, floral, woody and smoky accords. The opening is sharp and intense with leather, violet leaf, nutmeg and cinnamon. The middle brings floral tones of violet and rose combined with deep oud and cedar wood. The dry down is warm, earthy and rich with vetiver, sandalwood and amber giving it a timeless Arabic touch.

products.title: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Club De Nuit Sillage Eau De Parfum is a unisex fragrance launched in 2020. It is a bright and fresh perfume that opens with citrus and fruity notes of bergamot, lemon, black currant, lime, violet leaf, and ginger. The middle notes are soft florals like rose, iris, and jasmine and the final notes settle into a classy combination of ambroxan, musk, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a fragrance that feels clean, modern, and versatile, perfect for everyday wear or special evenings.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Oud & Roses is a unisex fresh floriantel Eau de Parfum from the Ahmed Al Maghribi fragrance house. It has a vibrant open of zesty lemon balanced by floral peony lavender and turkish rose, a heart of warm sandalwood, frankincense and white flowers and a musky-amber base mixed with oud, oakmoss, and guaiac wood.

products.title: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Blue Homme Eau De Parfum was launched in 2013 by Ajmal fragrance house that is based in UAE as a fresh aquatic scent with a touch of citric and floral notes. It opens with Citric bergamot, flowery lavender and fruity watermelon; with time it diffuses off the top notes and the heart notes of Lotus and jasmine becomes more prominent and finally it has a soft and musky drydown with its amber, musk and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and modern unisex fragrance that beautifully blends fruity sweetness with soft floral touches and warm woody notes. Inspired by royalty and calm blue skies, this scent opens with juicy pear and sweet citrus notes that instantly lift your mood.

At its heart, Ahmed Al Maghribi Azure Royal Eau de Parfum blooms with freesia and rose, giving a clean and graceful floral vibe. The base is warm and comforting with soft musk and smooth cedarwood, adding depth and a gentle touch of luxury that stays with you all day.

If you love fragrances that feel light yet royal, Azure Royal is a perfect choice for daily wear, special dinners, and every moment you want to feel fresh and confident.

products.title: Lattafa Badee al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Noble Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy, and elegant perfume made for women who love a sweet and warm scent. It starts with the gentle smell of rose milk, creating a smooth floral opening that feels cozy and romantic. The middle brings meringue and almond, adding a sweet, creamy note that feels like soft dessert air. The dry down is a mixture of vanilla, musk, and sandalwood that is serene, creamy, and slightly woody; thus, it is perfect for day and night.

products.title: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa His Confession Eau de Parfum is a bold and deep scent for men. It’s a warm oriental-woody perfume that mixes spicy, sweet and smoky tones beautifully. The fragrance opens with cinnamon, lavender and mandarin for a spicy-fresh start. The middle brings soft iris, cypress, benzoin and floral mahonial. The base settles into creamy vanilla, tonka, amber, incense, cedarwood and patchouli giving a rich and warm trail.

products.title: Lattafa Bade'e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bade’e Al Oud Amethyst Eau de Parfum is a unisex fragrance with a smooth and elegant oriental vanilla scent. Launched in 2021, it opens with fresh and spicy top notes of pink pepper and bergamot, followed by the floral heart of Turkish rose, Bulgarian rose, and jasmine. The base is rich and warm with agarwood (oud), amber, and vanilla.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Safa Perfume is an easy-going, a bit romantic, and modern ladies' scent that gives off the impression of being both refreshing and warm simultaneously. The first note to reveal itself is the almost intoxicating mixture of juicy lychee and red fruits along with a barely perceptible touch of nuttiness, which is all very cheerful and silky. With the time passing, one can feel the soft floral notes of rose and magnolia on the skin, and they are nothing but classy. The dry-down is a lovely combination of vanilla and gourmand notes that create a feel of warmth and creaminess, which is so comforting that it lingers for many hours.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Pistachio Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, unisex scent. Launched in 2023, it is a dessert style fragrance profile made with pistachio, ice cream, bergamot, hazelnut, cardamom and rum (top notes); pear, jasmine, peony, geranium, raspberry and white peach (heart notes) and whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, tonka bean and cedarwood (base notes) blended softly into a playful and smooth composition with gourmand sweetness and fruity floral touch that feels cozy and addictive.

products.title: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Mystique Bouquet Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and very feminine fragrance made for women who love fresh floral scents with a fruity touch. It was perfumed in 2024. This perfume starts with a cheerful and playful opening of bright and juicy fruits. Gentle flowers that make the scent clean and elegant come through as the fragrance settles. The base is warm and creamy, with a hint of sweetness, making the scent comforting and long lasting.

products.title: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rayhaan Tiger Eau de Parfum is a bold, woody, spicy perfume for men who like strong yet smooth perfumes. It opens with a warm, spicy blend of nutmeg, clove and lemon that feels fresh yet deep. The middle has a soft, creamy touch of milk blended with rose and davana, offering a slightly sweet, smooth texture. The base settles into creamy notes of amber, patchouli, frankincense and labdanum that feel warm, resinous and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam White Intense Eau De Parfum is a warm and creamy unisex fragrance, which is smooth to the touch and a bit sweet. The introduction is a fresh combination of bergamot, orange and soft spices, which createsa bright but warm introduction. Gradually, coconut and ylang ylang blend into a rich and soothing creamy floral heart. The musk and sandalwood foundation gives the skin a rich, warm woody fragrance that lingers in the skin for many hours. This perfume is classy, contemporary and suited to those who like warm oriental perfumes with a smooth twist.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Opulence Eau de Parfum is a rich and smooth oriental floral scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2025, this perfume feels classy, warm and modern at the same time. It opens with a juicy pear mixed with fresh bergamot and a little spicy ginger, which feels bright and clean. The heart is soft and floral with orange blossom and jasmine, balanced by gentle woody notes. As it dries down, vanilla, musk and amber come together to give a warm, sweet and cozy feel.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Parfum (2024 Launch)
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Parfum is an opulent and luxurious women's perfume that has a warm, creamy, and a bit sweet character. The fragrance starts with gentle spices and a light fruity note that feels soft on the skin. As time goes on, the heart turns to floral and sweet with a creamy caramel note that feels decadent. The base is made up of amber, vanilla, and sandalwood which provide a profound and enduring finish. This fragrance exudes the qualities of elegance, daring, and it is suitable for night time and special occasion use.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Confection Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and playful scent made for women who enjoy dessert like perfumes. It opens with juicy pear and fluffy whipped cream notes that feel soft and tasty. The heart has floral jasmine and ylang ylang mixed with warm cashmeran, which adds a cozy feel. The base dries down to smooth vanilla, marshmallow and sandalwood, leaving a sugary, soft and comforting trail that feels feminine and addictive.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Le Parfum is a daring and opulent scent for women that appears to be a rich blend of warm and mildly sweet. Initially, it shows the fresh explosion of ginger, saffron, and citrus notes that provide a spicy and exhilarating start. The middle of orange blossom and lavender contributes a delicate and floral scent, while the bottom of bourbon vanilla, honey, tonka bean, and vetiver gives a creamy and very lasting smelly cloud. This perfume smells contemporary, assertive, and suitable for the ladies who enjoy warm and classy scents.

products.title: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Shuhrah Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy fragrance for the modern man. The fragrance begins with the very lively and vibrant top notes of tomato leaf, rose and freesia. It then transforms into a floral and woody heart of rose, sandalwood, cedar and jasmine. Finally, it wraps up with a base that provides a rich and warm finish through the combination of leather, oud, musk, oakmoss and amber.

products.title: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Hunter Intense Eau de Parfum is a masculine woody aromatic fragrance from the house of Armaf. It starts with a burst of citrus freshness from bergamot, pomelo, mandarin, orange and lemon and in the middle notes, a floral twist with lavender, geranium, tuberose and ylang-ylang then balances freshness with elegance. The final notes end in a warm and spicy trail of black pepper and cardamom, creating a bold yet smooth finish. This fragrance is designed for men who like energetic, confident and modern scents that last throughout the day.

products.title: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Man In Black Eau De Parfum is a bold and modern men’s fragrance from the house of Bvlgari. Released in 2014, it carries a rich oriental floral DNA that is strong yet smooth. The perfume opens with spicy warmth blended with sweet rum and smoky tobacco. In the heart, the scent moves into leathery tones mixed with iris and tuberose. The dry down is deep with creamy tonka bean, smoky guaiac wood, and resinous benzoin, making it dark, masculine, and lasting.

products.title: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Prive Rose Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and romantic floral women’s perfume for those who love elegant rose perfumes. Launched in 2023, this fragrance opens with juicy plum, which feels slightly fruity and fresh. The middle is full of rose petals and peony, giving it a creamy floral touch that smells clean, smooth and very feminine. The base settles into warm ambroxan, creamy vanilla and soft musk, which makes the scent feel cozy and long lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Fakhar Gold Extrait De Parfum is a rich and classy perfume for men from the famous house of Lattafa. It opens with a bright, spicy touch of grapefruit, pink pepper and cardamom. The middle mixes soft tuberose with warm solar notes and herbal artemisia. The dry down is deep and comforting, filled with amber, leather, labdanum and smooth cashmeran.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: In the world of perfume, Prada Paradoxe Eau De Parfum is one of the certainly women's fragrances that are soft, fresh, and modern that smell clean and elegant. Fresh fruity accords of pear and citrus notes with their bright and smooth character immediately attract attention. Very gently, the white flowers likened to orange blossom and jasmine take the front, thus creating a creamy and feminine aura. At the end of the day, vanilla and amber bring in warmth and softness that remain on the skin for a long time. The whole fragrance is classy, soft, and ideal for everyday use.

products.title: Lattafa Petra Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Petra Eau de Perrier by Lattafa Perfumes is a creamy and sweet unisex perfume that is warm and a tad bit boozy. The initial spray introduces the splendid rum and juicy plum, which add a dark fruity touch to this spray. Then there comes tuberose and coconut, and it is soft and creamy. The smooth sweet finish of vanilla, musk and praline in the base remains hours long.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Zeleny Eau de Parfum is a fresh and vibrant unisex perfume. Launched in 2023, it opens with a juicy and fruity burst of grapefruit, tangerine, strawberry and pineapple. The middle notes is floral with jasmine, orchid, peony and a touch of vanilla. Finally, it develops into a warm and luxurious base of oakmoss, musk and woody notes, leaving a smooth and lasting scent suitable for all events.

products.title: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Mahab Eau de Parfum is a new unisex floral scent from Nusuk Fragrances. Released in 2025, it offers a soft, fruity floral style, with light smoky and musky tones. The opening starts with incense, fennel, and sweet red fruits, giving a slightly warm and juicy feel. The heart blooms with peach, osmanthus and jasmine, which smells smooth and floral. The base settles into sandalwood, rose, and musk that feels creamy, gentle and long lasting on skin.

products.title: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Badee Al Oud Sublime Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex scent from the house of Lattafa Perfumes. It combines fresh, floral and woody notes that are very pleasant and have a long-lasting effect at the same time. The perfume starts with fruity and soft floral notes of apple, litchi and rose, which make a sweet and bright opening. As it develops, the heart reveals plum and jasmine that add a creamy floral depth. The base brings warm notes of moss, vanilla and patchouli, leaving a rich, elegant trail that remains for hours.

products.title: Ajmal Silver Shade Homme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SILVERSHADE HOMME Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic body spray designed for men who value invigorating freshness and modern style. This dynamic fresh deodorant opens with an uplifting blend of citrus and fruity notes, instantly energising your senses. The heart reveals aromatic florals paired with cool spices, adding a sophisticated layer. A base of soft woods and musk ensures a smooth, lasting finish that feels clean and assured.

products.title: Tom Ford Ombre Leather Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Ombré Leather Parfum is an intense, velvety, and daring leather fragrance that exudes sophistication and luxury. It starts with a delicate green hint of violet leaf and dry cedar, then gradually transitions to a pure floral heart with jasmine and orris. The foundation is a blend of leather, wood notes, and a faintly tobacco-like smell, which are all three very strong. This fragrance gives off a powerful, self-assured, and contemporary vibe which is ideal for those who are fans of leather perfumes with a strong presence.

products.title: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ansaam Gold Eau de Parfum is a rich oriental floral perfume designed for women who love warm and sweet scents. The perfume opens with a soft and fruity mixture of Mandarin Orange and Pear, then the heart of Jasmine, Rose, and sweet notes wrap the fragrance giving it a smooth and creamy touch. The base is Vanilla, Musk, and Raspberry that impart a warm sweetness which is very beautifully intimate with the skin.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Laathani Extrait de Parfum is a rich, bold and graceful unisex fragrance from the house of Ahmed Al Maghribi Fragrances known for its beast-level longivity and projection. It is a find blend of fresh bergamot and fruity pear top, floral rosemary and warm oud heart, and smoky bakhoor and heavy leather base.

products.title: Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The fragrance Parfums De Marly Layton Eau De Parfum is a fresh and rich perfume with a little touch of sweetness that gives a classy and smooth feeling. The fragrance begins with an appealing combination of apple, lavender, and citrus that is very much like clean and bright. The whole palette of notes is huge, and at first, it is floral, soft and elegant, but slowly it is giving its way to the vanilla and woody notes that are now warm and deep. The scent is luxurious, self-assured, and extremely delightful, and it would be just right for those men who love the combination of fresh and sweet perfumes.

products.title: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Instant Crush Eau De Parfum is a warm, bright and spicy unisex scent that mixes sweet florals with fresh citrus and deep musky notes. The scent opens strong with saffron, ginger, mandarin and bergamot, giving a bold and shiny start. In the middle, you get amberwood, Moroccan rose, Egyptian jasmine and patchouli leaf that add a soft but rich touch. The dry down of vanilla, white musk, sandalwood and oakmoss makes the perfume smooth, creamy and long-lasting.

products.title: Ajmal Raindrops Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Raindrops Eau de Parfum is a soft and elegant women's perfume who like clean and fresh scents. It is a lovely combination of soft, sweet and woody that is very feminine and delicate. The perfume is at first very soft and fruity with floral accents, then gradually leads to a warm base of wood and amber.

products.title: Ajmal Sacred Love Femme Deodrant
products.body_html: Ajmal SACRED LOVE Deodorant is a 200ml non-alcoholic women’s body spray that celebrates femininity and grace. This exquisite Ajmal Sacred Love deodorant opens with a refreshing blend of citrus and delicate fruits, creating an uplifting first impression. The heart blossoms into a lush bouquet of florals, perfectly balanced by warm woody and musky undertones that linger beautifully on the skin.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Eau De Parfum is a women's fragrance that is gentle but at the same time daring, it is elegant and modern at the same time. The top notes are a fresh and somewhat spicy combination of black currant and pink pepper that is bright and cheerful. The heart gradually gives way to the flower notes and among them are the most wonderful jasmine notes that are pure and graceful. The base consists of warming, smoothing bourbon vanilla and gentle woods that linger on the skin for hours in a very subtle way.

products.title: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Maahir Gold Eau De Parfum is a beautiful unisex perfume that mixes floral, fruity and warm oriental notes. The opening consists of red berries, peach and bergamot that are very sweet and juicy so they create a fresh and playful start. The heart reveals soft blossom of jasmine, peony and red lily. Then, the base of sandalwood, vanilla flower and musk create a creamy and warm dry-down that is become smart and long-lasting.

products.title: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Haya Eau de Parfum is a charming and classy scent made for women who like something soft yet fresh. It opens with a sweet fruity sparkle of strawberry, champagne and tangerine, mixed with a hint of blood orange and rose. The middle of the perfume is made of gardenia, jasmine and vanilla orchid that provide a smooth floral note. The cozy finish is created by warm amber, sandalwood and chestnut in the base note, which also makes it close to the skin.

products.title: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Musk Silk Supreme Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal Scents. This perfume is all about smooth musk blended with gentle floral and warm amber tones. It opens with a fresh and calming touch of lily of the valley, giving a clean and airy feel. As it settles, creamy musk takes over and stays close to the skin, making it comforting and classy. The warm amber and extra musk in the base contribute to the longevity of the fragrance and create a cozy feeling around it.

products.title: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Jaguar Classic Gold Eau De Toilette is a warm, woody, and fresh men’s fragrance that feels smooth and classy. It opens with a juicy combination of apple, bergamot and lime that gives a sharp bright start. Soon, the scent turns softer with orange blossom and teak wood, giving it a sweet woody middle. In the dry down, vanilla, patchouli and musk add a warm creamy finish that feels very comforting. It is simple, elegant, and a perfect everyday scent that feels clean and confident.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a glamorous fragrance for women that mixes bold dark notes with bright and sweet floral tones. Launched in 2016, this perfume became iconic not only for its scent but also for its stylish stiletto-shaped bottle. The fragrance opens with almond, coffee, bergamot, and lemon for a rich and addictive start. The heart blooms with tuberose, jasmine sambac, orange blossom, Bulgarian rose, and orris. The base is deep and warm with tonka bean, cacao, vanilla, praline, sandalwood, musk, amber, cashmere wood, patchouli, cinnamon, and cedar. Together, it creates a scent that feels powerful yet feminine, daring yet elegant.

products.title: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Khair Fusion Eau de Parfum is a fresh, fruity, floral unisex scent from Paris Corner fragrances. It starts with juicy, sweet fruits such as litchi, red apple, black currant and a hint of zesty Italian lemon, which makes it bright and playful. The heart opens gradually with gentle jasmine sambac, romantic Taif rose and powdery pansy fragrances that are smooth and light. The base settles into warm, creamy vanilla, musk, sandalwood, cedar and the smell is comfortable, sweet and long lasting with a soft, woody finish.

products.title: Montale Intense Cafe Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Montale Intense Café Eau De Parfum is a warm, sweet and cozy unisex scent that merges smooth coffee, soft rose and creamy vanilla. It was launched in 2013 and has that calm café vibe with a touch of sweetness and a gentle musky base.

products.title: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Eau De Parfum for Men is a delightful fragrance that masterfully communicates the spicy and sweet notes in its own classy way. The first impression consists of black pepper, lavender, and bergamot, which provide the freshness, after which the heart notes of orris, cloves, and cinnamon give the warmth. The base consists of the very deep and sophisticated notes of black vanilla husk, tolu balsam, tonka bean, benzoin, and patchouli.

products.title: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Azure Velvet Extrait de Parfume is a fresh and smooth citrus perfume that is applied by women and men. The initial spray is a cool blend of bergamot, lavender and mint that is refreshing and invigorating. It has slow, soft, fruity, and flowery notes coming in slowly, giving it a touch of light sweetness. Woody notes, powdery accords and incense form a cool, slightly smoky, enduring finish that lingers on the skin hours later in the dry down. It is contemporary, stylish, and comfortable to put on at all times.

products.title: Ajmal Shadow Femme Deodrant
products.body_html: The Ajmal Shadow Perfume Deodorant is the ultimate fragrance choice for the modern woman who seeks to leave a lasting impression. With its enticing blend of floral and woody notes, this perfume deodorant is designed to captivate the senses and accentuate your unique allure.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Not a Perfume Eau de Parfum is a soft and non-polluting perfume for women. This fragrance was introduced in 2010 and was produced by Romano Ricci using only one note, which is Cetalox. It is light, musky, and a little woody with a refreshing feel on the skin. It is incorporated with your natural perfume and is a casual, contemporary, and comfortable daily wear.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Myslf Eau De Parfum is the new-age scent of modern confidence. It’s a fragrance that celebrates being your true self, fresh, clean, and effortlessly stylish. Created for the man who is not afraid to show his sensitive side, this perfume beautifully combines bright citrus with a clean floral heart and a warm, woody base.

YSL Myslf is incredibly versatile and easy to wear. It’s the perfect companion for every part of your day, from a busy morning at the office to a relaxed evening with friends. A spray of Yves Saint Laurent Myslf feels like putting on your favorite crisp shirt, it gives you a boost of freshness and makes you feel put-together and ready for anything.

products.title: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Black Orchid Eau De Parfum is a bold, dark and rich women’s perfume. Black Orchid was launched in 2006 and was created by David Apel and Pierre Negrin. It opens with deep and slightly sweet notes that feel warm and luxurious. As it settles, floral and spicy tones come out slowly and smoothly. The base feels creamy, chocolatey and woody, which stays on the skin for long hours.

products.title: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Be Eau de Toilette is a unisex fragrance that blends fresh, floral, and woody notes to create a calm and natural vibe. Launched in 1996, it opens with a combination of lavender, citrus, and mint for a fresh start. The middle notes have soft floral and green notes like jasmine, peach, and magnolia. The base is warm and comforting with musk, sandalwood, cedar, vanilla, and amber, giving a smooth finish for everyday wear.

products.title: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Bright Crystal Eau de Toilette is a fresh, soft, and very feminine perfume made for women who love light and clean scents. It opens with a fresh mix of yuzu and pomegranate that feels juicy and bright. Slowly, the floral heart of peony, lotus, and magnolia comes out and feels smooth and gentle. The base of musk and amber gives a soft warmth that stays close to skin. This perfume feels elegant, fresh, and perfect for daily wear.

products.title: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Oud Mood Eau De Parfum is a warm, rich and deep unisex perfume from the well-known house of Lattafa. It has a strong Middle Eastern touch with spicy, sweet and woody notes. The scent opens with a soft mix of rose, saffron and a little peppery pimento. In the middle, you get caramel, floral notes, patchouli and a beautiful oud tone that gives a dark and sweet feel. The dry down is warm with amber, resins, musk, incense and woody notes that stay long on skin and clothes.

products.title: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Homme Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is made for men, but at the same time, fresh, cool, and warm. A bright and cheerful combination comes from opening notes of mint, lime, and rum, with the latter being very delicate. The middle notes containing flowers make the scent softer and more comfortable to be around. Woods of vetiver, cedar, and patchouli in the base result in a warm, earthy, and very intimate finish. This is a no-fuss but elegant perfume that is suitable for everyday and night use.

products.title: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Valentino Donna Born In Roma Intense Eau De Parfum for Women is a deep, warm, and elegant perfume which was made for the ladies who are self-assured. To begin with, there is a fragrant mixture of vanilla and amber which is strong, sweet and daring. The mid of the perfume consists of the gentle scent of jasmine that gives a delicate touch of flowers. The end notes are the warm and comforting ones which make the scent last for a long time and suit night, parties and special occasions.

products.title: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Gucci Bloom Eau De Parfum is a floral perfume with a fresh, soft scent, and it is made for women who appreciate simple, pure and elegant perfumes. At the beginning, the sweet scent of jasmine is predominant, then creamy and rich tuberose prevails, and finally, the unusual floral note of rangoon creeper is perceived. This perfume was created in 2017 by Alberto Morillas, and it feels natural, feminine and smooth on the skin. The scent is intimate, leaving a delicate and long-lasting floral aura that many women like to wear during the day and at night.

products.title: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Asad Zanzibar Eau de Parfum is a bold and fresh fragrance for men. Launched in 2024 by Lattafa Perfumes, it blends unique spicy, floral, and sweet notes into a smooth, long-lasting scent. The top notes of lavender and black pepper give a fresh and spicy start. The heart notes of coconut water, iris, and salt make it clean and calming. Finally, the base notes of vanilla and incense leave a warm and slightly sweet trail that lasts all day.

products.title: Byredo Bal D'afrique Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Byredo Bal D'Afrique Eau de Parfum is a warm and elegant unisex fragrance inspired by African culture and Parisian spirit. Launched in 2009, this scent beautifully combines citrus, floral, and woody notes in a smooth balance. It opens with fresh Amalfi lemon, marigold, bergamot, black currant, and African orange flower. The middle notes of violet, cyclamen, and jasmine give it a soft floral charm, while the base of vetiver, musk, amber, and Virginia cedar adds depth and long-lasting warmth.

products.title: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Pistachio Gelato 33 is a sweet, creamy, and playful scent that is reminiscent of cold pistachio ice cream on a hot summer day. The fragrance starts with a nutty mix of pistachio, hazelnut, and a soft, cold ice-cream vibe that appeals and tempts. Then it proceeds to a fruity floral heart where jasmine, white peach, and pear are the main contributors and they deliver smooth and fresh sweetness. The last layer consists of whipped cream, marshmallow, cotton candy, and cacao, which gives the skin a warm, sweet, and cozy feel. It’s a happy gourmand scent for anyone whose taste in perfumes swings to the side of creamy, sweet, and dessert-like ones.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris Eau de Parfum is a modern, romantic, and dazzling fragrance that feels like a passionate love affair in the city of Paris. It captures the intense feeling of falling in love. This beautiful scent opens with a sweet and juicy burst of red berries and pear, instantly making you feel happy and amazing. It then settles into a lovely heart of white flowers, creating a truly feminine and charming experience.

Mon Paris is for the woman who is passionate, modern, and lives freely. It is a perfect combination of sweet, floral, and warm notes that makes it incredibly easy to wear and love. One spray of Yves Saint Laurent Mon Paris will envelop you in a beautiful aura of romance and elegance, making every moment feel truly special.

products.title: Diptyque Orpheon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is a classy, modern unisex fragrance that feels warm, cozy, and stylish all at once. Inspired by the lively nights of Paris in the 1960s, Orphéon evokes memories of jazz bars, wooden furniture, and powdery notes reminiscent of soft skin and warm drinks.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum opens with a fresh, slightly spicy touch of juniper berries, which feels crisp and clean. The heart of jasmine adds a gentle floral note that balances beautifully with the warm base of powder, cedarwood, and smooth tonka bean.

Diptyque Orphéon Eau de Parfum is perfect for people who love fragrances that feel both fresh and comforting. This perfume feels like wearing a stylish blazer with a soft scarf, easy, elegant, and always inviting.

products.title: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Calvin Klein All Eau de Toilette is a fresh unisex fragrance from the house of Calvin Klein. Launched in 2017, it carries the modern spirit of youth and freedom with a clean citrus profile. The perfume opens with a burst of bergamot, mandarin orange, and grapefruit blossom giving a bright and zesty start. The heart notes bring out jasmine, rhubarb, freesia, and lily adding a soft floral touch with a hint of green freshness. Finally, the dry down settles into warm and smooth notes of musk, amber, and vetiver, making it a balanced scent that feels both uplifting and comforting.

products.title: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Minya Cocolush Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, fruity and floral scent with a creamy gourmand twist. Launched in 2024, this fragrance opens with fresh, juicy notes of coconut water, raspberry and pear that feel light and happy. The heart blooms with jasmine and freesia, giving a gentle floral touch. The dry down turns warm and tasty with macarons, musk and amber, making the scent cozy, smooth and slightly dessert like but not heavy.

products.title: Kayali Rock Sugar 42 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Vanilla Candy Rock Sugar 42 is a playful and sweet perfume that resembles a candy shop visit. The fragrance opens with a combination of creamy vanilla, juicy pear, and soft marshmallow, which gives the scent a warm sugary start. Soon the fragrance becomes even sweeter with the addition of bubble gum, jelly bean, and caramel, making it taste yummy and young. The base turns warm and comfortable with sugar, tonka, patchouli, and soft woods that linger on the skin for a long time. It is a great choice for people who are into sweet, girlish, and cozy fragrances.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau De Parfum is a creamy, luscious and sophisticated scent for women that is utterly warm and enigmatic. The fragrance begins with a peppery the spicy touch of ginger, and cardamom that is bold and rich. Bit by bit, the gentle notes of coconut, gardenia, and orange blossom are revealed and they make the fragrance smooth and feminine. At the end, sandalwood, musk, and amber provide an elegant and enduring finish. This fragrance is characterized by sensuality, self-assurance, and suitability for special occasions.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum is a joyful, dreamy, and fresh fragrance for women who love to feel confident, young, and free-spirited. This new perfume is inspired by the beauty of blooming magnolia flowers, mixed with fruity and creamy touches that make you feel happy from the first spray.

Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia is playful yet elegant. The top notes bring juicy dewberry, soft coconut, and a splash of fresh orange. The heart is full of magnolia petals, jasmine sambac, ylang-ylang, and lily of the valley, giving a lovely floral touch. In the base, warm musk, patchouli, and blonde woods make Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia long-lasting and soft.

This fragrance is for women who want to stand out sweetly and freshly, whether at work, on a date, or at a special event. One spray of Gucci Flora Gorgeous Magnolia Eau de Parfum can lift your mood and add a touch of floral magic to your day.

products.title: Giorgio Armani Si Passione Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani Sì Passione Eau de Parfum is a light, floral, female fragrance, which is refreshing, sweet and very emotional. It begins with a fat pear and black currant with airy spiciness, which bruises the skin and is alive. Later on, there are soft flowers such as roses and jasmine, which make it very feminine. The woody and vanilla foundation is warm and makes it soft, classy, and durable on everyday or special occasions.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant, and modern floral fragrance made for today’s confident women. Launched in 2010, Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum brings together the timeless beauty of fresh roses, warm spices, creamy sandalwood, and smooth musk. The result is a gentle yet long-lasting perfume that makes you feel fresh, graceful, and feminine all day long.

This beautiful fragrance is perfect for daily wear or for special occasions when you want to feel extra special and noticed. One spray of Ajmal Wisal Eau De Parfum is enough to leave behind a delicate floral trail that feels comforting and classy at the same time.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Parfum is a soft, elegant and very feminine perfume. It reveals a combination of fresh rose and a delicate fruity touch of peach at the very beginning. The middle notes consist primarily of pure white musky scent, which is layered with the warmth of amber. The base consists of patchouli and sandalwood, which provide a smooth, woody finish.

products.title: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Ana Abiyedh Leather Eau de Parfum is a bold and luxurious unisex fragrance. Introduced in 2017, it literally combines all the notes of the fresh, spicy, and warm fragrance family making the whole composition leather-centric and smooth. The fruity and spicy mix of juniper berries, cardamom, pink pepper, and raspberry marks up the top notes. The middle has the floral and slightly hot scent of iris, ginger, and rose. The bottom or base note is composed of a combination of leather, white musk, and amber, which are rich and sensual thus leaving a long-lasting impression.

products.title: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aristocrat Eau De Parfum was launched in 2017 by Ajmal fragrance house based in UAE as a woody floral musk scent with a citric opening and a musky drydown. Alongside the zesty lime and bergamot notes, the opening is adorned with melon sweetness, the heart speaks of floral lily and jasmine while dancing in a musk wind; and the drydown is like a sunset- soft and satisfying with pleasant woody notes of amber, oud patchouli and cedar.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Al Haramain L'Aventure Intense Eau de Parfum is a strong and classy men’s perfume who like bold and fresh smell. It opens with a bright citrus touch of bergamot and lemon with soft elemi. The middle notes create a woody and floral landscape with lily of the valley and jasmine, which is creamy and clean at the same time. The base is warm and long lasting with musk, patchouli and amber that stays on the skin.

products.title: French Avenue Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vulcan Baie Eau de Parfum French Avenue is a fresh, fruitful and a bit warm perfume that is produced to suit both men and women. It opens with fat juicy black currant and blackberry with a fresh tint of bergamot and rosemary which feels good and cheerful. The vodka and raspberry are used in the middle with a sweet and smooth finish with a gentle floral touch. The fragrance is long lasting as the base is comfortable and full of musk, sandalwood, and amber.

products.title: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paris Corner Taskeen Caramel Cascade Eau de Parfum is a sweet, creamy, gourmand scent made for both men and women. Launched in 2024, it brings a delicious blend of caramel and milk in the opening, followed by soft notes of tonka bean and honey in the middle. The drydown settles into a warm base of vanilla and white musk, giving it a smooth, cozy finish that feels comforting and addictive.

products.title: Diptyque Doson Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Do Son Eau de Parfum is a luminous and elegant floral fragrance that captures the beauty of white‑flowers in full bloom. It opens with fresh touches of orange blossom and pink pepper that add a sparkling brightness, then evolves into rich tuberose and jasmine in the heart, and settles on warm musks and benzoin. It is created for both women and men who love refined, floral scents that feel both clean and seductive.

products.title: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Musamam Eau de Parfum is a bold unisex perfume made for those who love creamy and deep scents. It starts with a warm mix of saffron, lavender and fresh Italian mandarin that brings brightness and spice together. The heart opens with amberwood, cedar and geranium giving it a woody and slightly floral feel. The base of akigalawood, incense and labdanum adds smoky warmth that stays on skin for long hours.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Lazy Sunday Morning Eau de Toilette is a soft and clean perfume that smells like fresh sheets, warm sunlight and a slow, cozy morning. It is a soft and unisex aroma made up of lighthearted flowers, a little bit of pear, soft rose and iris in the middle and a velvety warm base of white musk, ambrette and a whisper of patchouli leaf.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is a bright, lively, and feminine fragrance that feels like a fresh morning in a blooming English garden. It’s playful yet elegant, the perfect mix for women who love feeling confident, happy, and graceful.

Created by the world-famous perfumer Francis Kurkdjian, this scent opens with the sparkling freshness of pomegranate and lemon, bringing an instant burst of energy. The heart unfolds with green apple, delicate rose petals, and soft geranium, adding a romantic, floral sweetness. Finally, it settles into a dreamy base of wisteria and jasmine, leaving a soft, lingering trail that feels fresh all day.

Burberry My Burberry Blush Eau de Parfum is like wearing your favourite floral dress on a sunny day, uplifting, elegant, and effortlessly charming.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Flora Gorgeous Gardenia Intense by Gucci is a woman's musky fragrance that is floral and based on wood. It is a new perfume that will be released in 2025. It is initially bright after which it gradually turns creamy and soft to the skin. Gardenia mixed with hedione to a feminine touch is soothing in the heart. The sandalwood base is also a source of warmth and long hours. It is classy, contemporary and somewhat addictive.

products.title: Calvin Klein DEFY Parfum
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Defy Parfum is a woody aromatic fragrance designed for men who love deep and daring scents. It was launched in 2023 and created by perfumer Pascal Gaurin. The perfume starts with spicy pink pepper and is followed by the calming and fresh touch of lavender then dries down to a unique warm base of cacao. The mix gives a balance of spicy, floral and gourmand notes making it a modern perfume for men.

products.title: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Wisal Layl Eau de Parfum is a rich and elegant unisex fragrance from the house of Ajmal. It is a soft yet deep floral scent with a warm oriental touch. The perfume opens with sweet fruity notes of blackcurrant and apricot mixed with fresh freesia. A beautiful rose with patchouli and gentle osmanthus flowers is felt in the middle of the perfume. The base is warm and very long lasting, with musk, oud and frankincense giving it an Arabic, luxurious feel.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez For Her Eau De Toilette is a soft, classy women’s perfume. It is known for its clean musky feel with light flowers and warm woods. This fragrance feels elegant but simple, not loud at all. It has a fresh and floral opening, gradually becoming creamy and warm on the skin. It is a perfume that feels very close, smooth and comforting, so that it is suitable for everyday use and special moments as well.

products.title: Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: The Dunhill Signature Amalfi Citrus Eau de Parfum is a fresh and clean perfume that is bright and classy on the skin of men. It starts off with a citrusy burst of lemon, bergamot and orange that is very fresh and invigorating. Gradually, it passes into a creamy centre of neroli, green tea and light spices, which are soothing and graceful. Vetiver, musk and soft woods form the base to providea clean woody finish which remains fresh on skin. This perfume is relaxed, luxurious and easy to wear.

products.title: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Bella Rouge Eau de Parfum is a soft yet bold feminine scent from Riiffs Perfumes. It is a pretty oriental floral perfume that opens with fresh, spicy notes of blood orange, pink pepper and lemon zest, giving a bright, lively feel. The heart opens to romantic damask rose, light freesia and relaxing tea leaf, and the smell is graceful and soft. The base settles into white musk, patchouli and amberwood, providing a warm and slightly sweet end that remains near the skin and is comforting.

products.title: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ajmal Aurum Summer Eau De Parfum is a feminine scent that was launched in 2020 by the Ajmal fragrance house based in the UAE as a vibrant and graceful fruity floral scent with a musk base that gives a creamy and soft drydown. It opens like a zesty fruit bowl on a warm summer day with its apple, pear, bergamot, red fruits, and mandarin orange; develops to the grace of a bouquet of rose, orange blossom, peony, osmanthus, and jasmine; and a soft drydown of a musky base with oakmoss, cedar, vanilla and sandalwood notes.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, playful and very feminine fragrance made for women who enjoy soft gourmand scents. It opens with juicy fruits and sweetness that feels bright and happy from the first spray. The heart is floral and creamy, giving it a smooth and elegant touch without feeling heavy. As it settles, Arabiyat Prestige Lah di Da For Her Eau de Parfum turns warm and comforting base with vanilla and soft musk.

products.title: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Kyoto Eau de Parfum is a soft, earthy floral fragrance inspired by Japanese culture and Ikebana, the art of flower arranging. Created by perfumer Alexandra Carlin, it blends the fresh, slightly sweet aroma of Turkish rose with earthy beetroot and deep smoky vetiver, balanced with a layer of incense. It's a calm, minimal, and artistic scent almost meditative in its personality, perfect for those who enjoy quiet elegance and nature-inspired perfumes.

products.title: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Burberry Brit for Her Eau de Toilette is a sweet and fresh fragrance that women who appreciate simple yet luxurious perfumes can use. The fragrance begins with a combination of green almond and lime, complemented by pear, making it light and cheerful. The smell evolves into a sweet mixture of sugar and almond that give a cozy and relaxing effect. The amber and vanilla base of the perfume forms a softness that is close to the body. This aroma is very classy and soothing, and can be utilised easily by people every day.

products.title: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Daarej Pour Femme Eau de Parfum is a sweet, soft and elegant women's fragrance. It opens with juicy fruity notes of peach, orange and bergamot mixed with fresh green accords that feel bright and happy. The heart comes with creamy white florals like jasmine, tuberose and orchid blended with heliotrope and lily-of-the-valley, giving a powdery, feminine touch. The dry down is warm and cozy with caramel, musk, sandalwood, vetiver, amber and patchouli creating a sweet yet classy scent trail that feels smooth and comforting.

products.title: Burberry London Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry London Eau de Parfum is a classic floral scent that exudes elegance and timeless appeal. Launched in 2006, this fragrance opens with sweet honeysuckle, fresh tangerine, and soft rose (top notes), followed by jasmine, tiare flower, peony, and clementine (middle notes) and finishes with warm musk, sandalwood, and patchouli (base notes). A perfect combination of freshness, florals, and warmth makes it one of the most loved Burberry perfumes for women.

products.title: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ahmed Al Maghribi Kawkab Eau de Parfum is a rich and modern unisex perfume with a strong oriental touch. It starts with a fruity and spicy mixture of mango, saffron, citrus and soft florals that are bright but warm at the same time. The middle note is amber, rose, iris and black tea that are smooth and slightly smoky. The base is deep, woody and very long lasting with oud, tonka bean, patchouli, musk and cedar, which gives it a bold and classy finish that feels lavish but is still easy to wear.

products.title: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Versace Crystal Noir Eau de Toilette is a lovely, elegant, and somewhat enigmatic fragrance for women that is reminiscent of creamy flowers. It begins with a spicy mix of pepper, cardamom, and ginger, which is fresh yet warm at the same time. It gradually transitions to a delicate floral heart where gardenia and orange blossom are rich and ladies-like. The combination of sandalwood, musk, and amber at the base provides a warm and clean finish, which is very close to the skin and feels very classy.

products.title: Lattafa Art of Nature 1 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Art of Nature Eau de Parfum is a luxurious unisex scent that blends the magic of nature with rich oriental notes. Launched in 2024, this perfume carries the freshness of fruits and the depth of woody warmth. It starts with figs, plums, and blackcurrants, which are of the best quality and then very slowly dissolve into the gentle center of leather, rhubarb, and rose. The base holds deep oud, smooth ambergris, and creamy vanilla, leaving an elegant and long-lasting trail on your skin.

products.title: Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum is an intense, sensual, and elegant fragrance that captures the essence of a rainy evening in London. Inspired by the iconic Burberry trench coat and the beauty of blooming flowers after the rain, this perfume blends floral richness with warm, deep notes for a luxurious experience.

The fragrance opens with a burst of jasmine, creating a bright yet smooth introduction. The heart reveals the sweetness of peach and the romantic elegance of rose, while the base wraps you in warm amber and earthy patchouli.

Burberry My Burberry Black Parfum feels like slipping into a classic trench coat on a rainy night, walking through a garden filled with blossoms, and enjoying the comforting embrace of warm, golden lights. It is perfect for women who want to feel confident, feminine, and unforgettable.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Delina Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Delina is an irresistible, sophisticated, soft floral scent that belongs to the group of women who are fond of fresh and romantic perfumes. The opening is a vibrant, rather sweet and quite pleasant, juicy combination of litchi and rhubarb. With a beautiful Turkish rose accompanied by peony and soft musk, the heart is slowly revealing itself. The base is warm and smooth, composed of woods and incense, thus making the scent elegant and of good duration.

products.title: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Mystere Eau de Parfum is a soft, elegant floral perfume for women who like sweet and classy scents. It opens fresh and fruity, then turns into creamy white flowers and finally dries down into warm vanilla and musk. The combination feels feminine, gentle and attractive.

products.title: Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Lancome La Vie Est Belle Eau De Parfum is a sweet and cheerful fragrance perfectly made for women. The opening notes reveal fresh blackcurrant and delightful pear that are light and fruity at the same time. The middle notes of iris, jasmine, and orange blossom give the fragrance a smooth and elegant touch with soft floral notes. The warm and comforting base composed of praline, vanilla, patchouli, and tonka bean also contributes to the fragrance being long-lasting and suitable for women who adore sweet, elegant, and happy scents.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Sun Song Eau de Parfum is a bright and fresh citrus perfume for women and men. It was released in 2019 and designed by Jacques Cavallier Belletrud. The perfume begins with a clear and juicy citron, which is clear and active. Orange blossom then adds the sweetness of a soft, floral taste. The musk in the bottom provides it with a smooth and warm feel that remains close to the skin. It reeks of summer sunshine, light, happy and easy to wear. Its weight is not excessive, it is not too sweet, and it is only fresh and glowing.

products.title: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Dylan Blue Woman Eau de Parfum is a new and elegant women’s fragrance that gives off a clean, fruity, and slightly floral vibe. It starts with a vivid combination of apple and black currant that feels juicy and fresh. Gradually, the perfume develops its floral note with rose and jasmine that feel classy and silky. The base notes consist of musk and soft woods, which are clean and comforting. This perfume seems to be chic, contemporary, and suitable for daily use.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Blush Eau de Parfum is a soft and romantic version of the iconic Good Girl line. Released in 2023, this fragrance brings a playful and feminine twist to the collection. It opens with the freshness of bergamot and almond, moving into a floral heart of peony and ylang-ylang. The base finishes with creamy vanilla and sweet coumarin, making the scent both warm and delicate. This perfume captures elegance, charm, and modern femininity in a light pink stiletto bottle that is as attractive as the fragrance inside.

products.title: Bvlgari  Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Bvlgari Rose Goldea Eau De Parfum produces a feminine and soft smell that is filled with a romantic and elegant touch. The smell has a fresh and rosy start with a delicate fruity scent that creates a clean and light impression. The fragrance evolves into a floral heart that harbours the smell of rose and soft flowers. The lower level of the perfume is a blend of warm fragrances and creamy musk, sandalwood and vanilla, which are still close to the skin. The perfume gives a very elegant, feminine smell that can be used on a daily basis.

products.title: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Goodness Oud Blanc Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet, oriental floral scent for both men and women. It opens with a romantic Damask rose and a creamy praline note that gives a sweet feel from the start. The middle features sugar, white musk and jasmine sambac, making the scent smooth, light, floral and cozy. Drydown has amber xtreme, vanilla and patchouli, giving a warm, long lasting base with a slightly sweet, woody touch.

products.title: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Prada Paradoxe Virtual Flower Eau de Parfum is a modern floral women’s perfume for those who like soft but noticeable fragrance. Launched in 2024, it brings a fresh and clean floral style built with bright bergamot in the opening, a heart of jasmine and neroli, and a soft musky base with ambrette.

products.title: Nusuk Ajwaa Concentrated Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Nusuk Ajwaa Concentrated Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity-floral women’s perfume for those who like soft yet noticeable perfumes. It opens with juicy notes of black currant, pear and rhubarb, which smell fresh and slightly tangy. The heart comes with white florals like orange blossom and tuberose mixed with rose, giving it a smooth, feminine feel. The dry down turns warm and creamy with sandalwood, woody notes and hazelnut, making the scent cozy and slightly nutty.

products.title: Khadlaj Nuha Vanilla Pearl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Khadlaj Perfumes Nuha Vanilla Pearl is a women's fragrance, Floral Fruity Gourmand. This is a new fragrance. In 2025, Nuha Vanilla Pearl was introduced. It begins with plump blackcurrant and strawberry mixed with sweet freesia. The heart also includes raspberry, cashmere wood and magnolia giving a creamy floral flavor. Its base is sweet and vanilla, caramel and moss-flavoured with a smooth and long-lasting finish.

products.title: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum
products.body_html: Narciso Rodriguez Bleu Noir Parfum is a deep, elegant men’s fragrance from the designer house of Narciso Rodriguez. Released in 2022, it is a smooth woody musk scent with a modern dark twist. The scent opens fresh and spicy with cardamom, citrus and cypress, then moves into a soft heart of iris, musk and suede. The base is creamy and warm with sandalwood, leather, vetiver and tonka bean, giving it a clean yet sensual masculine feel that works all year.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Gold Fantasy Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and stylish women's perfume experience, which is combined of sweet, warm and sophisticated components. The perfume starts out with an almond, which evolves into a creamy and smooth feel. The core of the perfume grows white flowers using jasmine sambac and tuberose that produce a feminine and classy aroma. A mix of cacao and tonka bean in the foundation produces a sweet and warm aroma and feels longer on the skin. The fragrance offers an assertive and luxurious feel, and this appeals to women who like strong perfumes.

products.title: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Yum Yum Eau de Parfum is a sweet fruity fragrance designed for ladies who adore subtle, playful scents. The top notes are juicy berries, cherry, and orange, which are fresh and fun. Gradually, rose, white flowers, and vanilla reveal their creamy and smooth characters. The bottom line is made up of powdery notes, musk, and amber, which combine to give a gentle warm finish. This perfume is to be considered feminine, comforting and friendly, and so it is ideal for everyday wear.

products.title: Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and charming fragrance for women who love to feel confident and graceful. Launched in 2024, this beautiful scent is like wearing a fruity-floral silk dress that turns heads wherever you go. Supremacy Tapis Rouge blends juicy fruits with soft florals, creating a modern perfume that feels playful yet classy.

A single spray of Afnan Supremacy Tapis Rouge Eau de Parfum wraps you in a sweet burst of black cherry and litchi, balanced with white peach and a heart of blooming roses and jasmine. The dry down brings a warm touch of vetiver, cloves, and soft peony, making the scent smooth, clean, and feminine. It’s a lovely daily signature for women who love fruity scents with a floral twist.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Pure Seduction Shimmer Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: Pure Seduction by Victoria's Secret is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women.

products.title: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Royal Blue Eau de Parfum is a fresh yet classy men’s perfume for those who like a clean but strong smell. It opens with watery sea notes mixed with citrus and green touch, then slowly turns floral and soft in the middle. The drydown is warm, woody and musky, which gives a creamy, long lasting feel.

products.title: Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: The Kayali Sweet Diamond Pink Pepper is a strong, spicy, and sweet fragrance that is bold but soft on the skin at the same time. It has a bright blend of pink pepper, saffron, and bergamot, with a spicy-sweet start, on top. After that, it goes to a magnificent rose and vanilla orchid heart, coming very floral, creamy, and a bit sweet. The bottom notes of amber, sandalwood, patchouli, and musk impart warmth, smoothness, and longevity to the fragrance. It is a perfume that exudes confidence, playfulness, and the ideal choice for a person who enjoys both sweet and spicy scents simultaneously.

products.title: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Jimmy Choo Illicit Eau de Parfum is a Women Floral perfume. Illicit was launched in 2015. The nose in this perfume is Anne Flipo. It begins with new and hot tones of ginger and bitter orange. It contains jasmine sambac, orange blossom and rose in the heart. The foundation is warm and salty with honey, amber, caramel, vanilla, sandalwood and wood of cashmere.

products.title: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Guerlain Absolus Allegoria Rose Amira is a deep, rich fragrance designed for women and men. It was released in 2024 and was designed by Delphine Jelk. The perfume is cosy, classy, and a bit oriental. The rose is in the middle, soft yet powerful. Its texture is soft and luxurious, and it clings to the body and is very classy.

products.title: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum is a creamy, deep and very luxurious unisex perfume. This fragrance feels smooth, warm and comforting with a strong artistic touch. It opens soft and slightly sweet, then slowly turns creamy, floral and woody. Amouage Guidance 46 Extrait de Parfum was launched in 2024 and the extract concentration makes it intense, long lasting and very elegant on the skin.

products.title: Kayali Yum Bougee Marshmallow 81 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Yum Boujee Marshmallow Eau de Parfum is a women's fragrance, a floral, fruity gourmand perfume. It was initiated in 2024 and designed by Gabriela Chelariu. It is a sweet, creamy and playful perfume that is targeted at people who are fond of sweet and tender aromatic fragrances. It is youthful, entertaining and somewhat luxurious.

products.title: Ibraheem Al Qurashi Sandalwood Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Sandalwood by Ibraheem Al Qurashi is a warm, soft, and slightly sweet Oriental Floral perfume that suits both women and men. It opens with a juicy combination of raspberry and deep damask rose, creamy and smooth. The middle adds a powdery touch, combined with dry cedarwood, giving the scent a calm, elegant feel. The base is creamy, warm, and comforting with amber and strong sandalwood that stays long and feels very cosy. It is a simple, classy, and relaxing perfume loved by many who enjoy soft woody scents.

products.title: Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid Eau de Parfum is a dreamy, modern floral perfume designed for the confident woman who loves sweetness with a touch of freshness. Inspired by the beauty of the exotic vanilla orchid, this fragrance mixes delicious vanilla with soft floral notes and a light, airy finish.

Wearing Gucci Flora Gorgeous Orchid feels like stepping into a magical garden filled with blooming orchids and a sweet breeze. It’s elegant, youthful, and perfect for women who want to feel fresh yet luxurious every day.

products.title: Givenchy L'interdit Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Givenchy L'Interdit Eau De Parfum for women is a bold, elegant, and modern floral perfume that brings a creamy white floral vibe with a warm and slightly dark twist. It opens with juicy pear and fresh bergamot, then moves into a rich mix of tuberose, jasmine sambac, and orange blossom for a bright and feminine floral heart. The base offers patchouli, vanilla, vetiver, and ambroxan, giving the scent a soft creamy finish with a deep warm touch.
This perfume is loved for its classy feel, long lasting performance, and confident aura that makes it perfect for women who like to stand out in a graceful way.

products.title: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Giorgio Armani My Way Eau de Parfum is a new floral perfume designed to appeal to women who prefer soft and classy scents. This perfume was introduced in 2020, and it begins with bright orange blossom and bergamot that is both clean and refreshing. The heart adds the creamy tuberose and Indian jasmine, which makes it feel richly floral. Vanilla, white musk and cedar in the base give it a feeling of warmth and smoothness, causing the scent to remain mild and cosy throughout the hours.

products.title: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Dunhill Mongolian Cashmere Eau de Parfum is a gentle and elegant perfume to men, which is warm and soft on the skin. It commences with a light spicy touch of pink pepper blended with fresh mandarin orange that is clean and fresh. Gradually, it shifts into a drying floral core of orris, geranium and rose that is relaxing and refined. The foundation of suede, amber and musk remains warm and comfortable for many hours, as soft cashmere.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum For Women
products.body_html: Calvin Klein Euphoria Intense Eau De Parfum for women is a modern, rich and seductive fragrance that was launched in 2021. It is a darker and more intense version of the original Euphoria. The perfume combines fruity freshness with sensual floral and woody notes, creating a bold statement for confident women. The composition opens with juicy black currant (top note), moves into exotic orchid (middle note), and dries down with deep earthy patchouli (base note).

products.title: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Afnan Cherry Bouquet Eau De Parfum is a sweet, playful women’s perfume. It opens with a strong cherry feel that smells juicy, a little boozy and slightly nutty. As it settles, soft fruits and florals come out, making it feel romantic and smooth. The base is warm, creamy and comforting with vanilla and woods that stay close to the skin. This perfume feels fun, cozy and perfect for someone who loves sweet cherry based scents.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent Libre Flower & Flames Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Libre Flowers & Flames by Yves Saint Laurent is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Libre Flowers & Flames was launched in 2024. Top notes are Lavender and Bergamot; middle notes are Orange Blossom, Lavender, Coconut, Lily and Palm Tree; base note is Vanilla.

products.title: Mancera  Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is a creamy, sweet and fruity unisex perfume. This fragrance opens with a blast of juicy fruits that feel bright, fresh and mouth watering.
