It has a sweet vibe but still feels classy and smooth. As the perfume settles, soft floral notes start to appear and balance the sweetness very well. The dry down is creamy, warm and musky, which stays on the skin for many hours. Mancera Jardin Exclusif Eau de Parfum is bold, strong and very long lasting, perfect for people who love fruity and sweet perfumes with power.

products.title: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Dancing on the Moon Eau de Parfum is a soft, dreamy and light fragrance made for both men and women. The fragrance is a combination of aldehydes with frangipani, jasmine sambac, and iris floral notes, giving the impression of a fresh night breeze. The base of the scent is composed of cashmeran, ambergris, and musk, which are warm notes that stay close to the skin.

products.title: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Fragrance World Varakh Gold Eau de Parfum is a luxurious and dignified perfume targeted at women who enjoy heavy and sophisticated aromas. It starts with a spicy bite of saffron and black pepper blended with fresh bergamot, and it is bold as one sprays the perfume. Gradually the odour turns warm and silky, including iris, balsam and soft woods. Its foundation is solid and lavishly oud, leather, patchouli, and sandalwood, with a long-lasting and superior touch

products.title: Givenchy  Gentleman Society Ambree Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Gentleman Society Ambrée EDP is an elegant, sensual, and strong perfume for men. Its journey begins with a spicy, rich top note, then smoothly transitions through the floral-woody middle note, and finally ends with the creamy smoky base note. The first puff includes nutmeg, clary sage, and juniper berries, after which orris, narcissus, sandalwood, and vetiver take over, and finally, the tobacco, soft vanilla, and Peru balsam unite in the dried down phase.

products.title: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Louis Vuitton Rose des Vents Eau de Parfum is a soft and fresh floral fragrance for women. It feels light, elegant, and very classy. The opening has juicy peach and black currant with green notes that give a clean and airy vibe. In the heart, different roses bloom with iris, making it powdery and smooth. The base of white musk, cedar, violet leaf and pepper adds a soft warm touch that stays close to the skin. It feels feminine, gentle, and very graceful.

products.title: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: Mugler Alien Goddess Eau de Parfum Intense by Mugler is a warm, creamy and glowing floral scent made for women who love soft sweetness with power. It opens with smooth coconut and fresh bergamot, which feels sunny and rich. The heart is full of jasmine and jasmine tea, giving a clean, white, floral touch that feels calm and elegant. The base has vanilla, benzoin and cashmere wood, making the perfume feel cozy, creamy and long lasting.

products.title: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lancome Idole Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume that is fresh, elegant, and at the same time, light and confident. It begins with a sweet and juicy blend of pear and bergamot and a hint of pink pepper for a little sparkle. Soft and floral heart is characterized by rose and jasmine, providing a gentle womanly feeling. The background is warm and smooth formed of white musk, vanilla, patchouli, and cedar that cling to the skin for hours. This perfume is modern, fresh, and ideal for women who appreciate clean, soft, and long-lasting fragrances.

products.title: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Sparkling Lychee 39 is a very sweet, fruity, and fresh perfume that is very bright from the first spray. The opening with juicy lychee, crisp red apple, and a tiny sparkle of lemon makes it very playful. In the middle, the soft violet, rose, and jasmine give a nice floral touch that is pleasant on skin. The dry down becomes warm and soothing with vanilla, sugar, musk, amber, sandalwood, and cedar. It is a cheerful, sugary, and girlish fragrance that is very suitable for daily use, informal occasions, and outdoor activities during the day.

products.title: Givenchy Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Givenchy Organza Eau De Parfum for women is a warm, elegant, and sensual fragrance that is classic and feminine. The first notes are spicy nutmeg, fresh bergamot, sweet gardenia, and soft flowers, then it is rich heart comprising tuberose, jasmine, iris, honeysuckle, and peony. The drydown is a mix of vanilla, amber, cedarwood, guaiac wood, and soft woods making it creamy and deep. The fragrance is described as a timeless scent with a smooth sweet and floral blend, which is ideal for women who prefer a bold but elegant perfume.

products.title: Giorgio Armano My Way Eau de Parfum Intense
products.body_html: My Way Intense Giorgio Armani is a female oriental flower fragrance. It was released in 2021, and the nose behind this fragrance is Carlos Benaïm. It begins with bitter orange and orange blossom, which makes the beginning of the fragrance very bright and slightly sweet. The rich Indian tuberose, which feels creamy and strong, is in the heart. Madagascar vanilla and sandalwood are used in the base to give a warm and long-lasting touch.

products.title: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette
products.body_html: Elizabeth Arden White Tea Eau De Toilette is a beautiful scent in the Woody Floral Musk group, made to capture a feeling of peaceful, quiet calm and easy elegance. It starts with a citrusy smell of Mandarin. The middle of the scent moves into a smooth, dry softness, where the gentle touch of White Tea is nicely lifted by the soft, almost powdery feel of Iris and a light, green herb note. The final part rests on a comforting, skin-close foundation: three quiet Musks blend with warm, comforting Madras Wood and Ambrette Seed, creating a subtle, lasting fragrance that feels polished and lovely for wearing every day.

products.title: Diptyque Lilyphea Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Diptyque Lilyphea is a fragrance that evokes the peaceful feel of a water‑lily pond at dawn. With violet leaf creating a fresh green shimmer, the gentle spice of cardamom and ginger adds lift, and the soft warmth of bourbon vanilla provides comfort and elegance. The result is subtle yet refined, a nature‑inspired scent that feels serene and modern. According to Diptyque, the fragrance captures the spirit of the water lily leaf — crisp, sap‑filled, soft.

products.title: Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Calvin Klein Euphoria Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is made for women who love to feel confident and glamorous, and it was launched in 2005. This perfume combines fruity, floral and woody notes into a smooth and sensual composition. It opens with juicy pomegranate, sweet persimmon and a green accord. The middle notes bloom with exotic black orchid, lotus and champaca. Finally the base settles into warm mahogany, amber, black violet and creamy whipped notes.

Winner of the FiFi Award Fragrance of the Year Women’s Luxe 2006 Euphoria is one of the most popular perfumes from Calvin Klein known for its long-lasting performance and sensual appeal.

products.title: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Armani Prive Rose D'arabie Eau De Parfum is a luxurious unisex perfume from Armani Prive. Launched in 2010, it is a creamy oriental floral fragrance that combines classic Middle Eastern ingredients with a modern elegance. The scent opens with fresh rose and floral notes, moves to middle notes of agarwood and patchouli, and finishes with warm vanilla for a sensual, lasting impression. It’s perfect for people who love strong, elegant, and sophisticated perfumes.

products.title: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Grecia White Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and elegant unisex perfume made for people who like calm but noticeable scents. It opens with a smooth milky note mixed with ambrette, giving a clean and comforting feel. The heart has white florals like tuberose and jasmine with a light touch of incense that adds depth but is not smoke heavy. The base is warm and sweet with vanilla, musk, tonka bean and cacao, which stays gentle on skin for a long time.

products.title: Creed Queen of Silk Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Queen of Silk Eau De Parfum is a royal and modern unisex fragrance that feels soft like silk but smells rich like gold. Inspired by the flowing Silk Roads of the East and the luxurious fashion of royalty, this perfume blends fruity sweetness, creamy florals, and soft woody notes in a way that feels timeless yet modern.

The opening feels bright and slightly juicy, thanks to saffron and magnolia, while the heart brings a creamy floral touch with tuberose and passionfruit. As it dries down, the base becomes smooth, woody, and slightly warm with oud, ambroxan, and Madagascar vanilla, giving Creed Queen of Silk its signature rich elegance.

This fragrance is made for those who love luxury but with a soft and graceful personality. Whether you’re dressing up for a wedding or want to feel special every day, Creed Queen of Silk adds charm, softness, and sophistication to your presence.

products.title: Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Byredo Black Saffron Eau de Parfum is a perfume for both men and women. It feels warm, a bit mysterious, and very rich when you wear it. The perfume is inspired by saffron, which is a very special spice. It has a combination of sweet, spicy, and earthy smell that make it bold but still very elegant.

The perfume start with saffron, juniper berries and fresh citrus from Chinese grapefruit, giving a spicy and bright opening. In the middle, you get soft leather and gentle black violet that add some depth and floral touch. Later it settle down into raspberry, cashmeran and vetiver, which give a woody, musky and little sweet finish that stay for long.

products.title: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Velvet Orchid Eau De Parfum is a sumptuous, sugary, and elegant perfume for women that has a warm, and luxurious feeling. The top notes are represented by a delicate and mellow combination of honey, rum, and citrus that is soft and welcoming. The floral part is composed of orchid, jasmine, rose, and magnolia and makes the scent feel like its melting and softening into a woman. The warm notes of vanilla, sandalwood, and suede are the last to be felt and give depth and long-lasting warmth to the scent. This perfume feels to be the combination of elegance, audacity, and the best choice for women who are confident.

products.title: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Neesh Splendid Rose Extrait De Parfum is a soft, rich and elegant rose-based perfume made for women who truly love floral scents. It opens with a fresh and bright rose mixed with citrus fruits, which feels clean and uplifting. As the scent settles, it becomes more floral and smooth with jasmine and lily adding a gentle sweetness. With deep warmth, the base remains and continues with the scent of earth, resin and woody notes that linger on the skin for hours.

products.title: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Marc Antoine Barrois Tilia Eau de Parfum is a soft, airy and elegant unisex fragrance. It feels bright, floral and very comforting on the skin. The scent opens with fresh lime blossom mixed with jasmine sambac and broom, giving it a light, sunny feel. The heart turns creamy and smooth with heliotrope, orange blossom and vetiver. The base is clean, woody and slightly musky with Ambrofix™ and Georgywood, making the scent long lasting and modern.

products.title: Kayali Elixir 11 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Kayali Elixir 11 is a scent that is warm, deep, slightly sweet and feels bold right from the first spray. It is a fresh and soft sweet start, as the opening has rose petals mixed with juicy red apple touch. The heart has May rose and jasmine sambac in which the perfume smells floral, smooth, and a bit romantic. Later, patchouli, amber, and vanilla sink into the skin and give a rich, dark sweetness that lasts long. This fragrance is rich and confident, and it is ideal for those who love bold, sweet, floral perfumes.

products.title: Hermes Voyage d'Hermes Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Hermes Voyage d’Hermes Eau de Toilette is a fresh, clean and soft woody fragrance for both men and women. It opens bright with cardamom, lemon and light spices that feel lively and uplifting, then moves into smooth tea notes with green and floral touches that add a calm feeling. The dry down is warm and gentle with woods, musk and cedar, giving a soft, cosy finish. It feels elegant, simple, and easy to wear for daily life, perfect for people who like a clean, refreshing scent that still feels classy.

products.title: Dolce & Gabbana Light Blue Eau Intense For Woman Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Light Blue Eau Intense for women by Dolce & Gabbana boasts a refreshing Mediterranean summer character. It contains a citrus and green apple head note that transitions to soft, feminine floral notes resting on a warm, musky amberwood base. The perfume opens with lemon and Granny Smith apple, along with the heart note of jasmine and marigold, and rests on a gorgeous base of amberwood and musk. This is a bold and strong Eau De Parfum that lasts longer than earlier releases. Additionally, it offers versatility to wear every day, or as a complex fragrance, suitable for occasions that call for it.

products.title: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera 212 Men NYC Eau de Toilette is a new, clean, modern perfume that brings the smooth, refined touch of its perfume. The perfume opens with the notes of green, grapefruit and light spices that give the impression of freshness and vigour. The perfume evolves into a calm, sophisticated condition with the soft floral and spicy tones, which are brought out in the process of settling. The base has woody and musky components, and these components stay on the skin longer.

products.title: Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html:
Creed Royal Mayfair Eau de Parfum is a bold, classy, and refreshing fragrance made for royalty and for those who live like one. Inspired by the Duke of Windsor and the upscale Mayfair district in London, this scent feels luxurious, clean, and crisp. It perfectly blends aromatic, floral, and green notes with a soft woody base to create a refined signature scent.

Creed Royal Mayfair smells like confidence in a bottle. It starts fresh and sharp, thanks to British gin and lime, and then flows into sweet rose and smooth eucalyptus, finishing with soft cedarwood. Whether you’re heading to a formal dinner, an office meeting, or a classy brunch, Royal Mayfair will leave a polished and sophisticated impression.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Pearl Extrait de Parfum is a tender, sweet and touch spicy female perfume that is rich and contemporary in its touch and feel. The introduction is sweet and crisp with plump rambutan and grapefruit with a touch of cardamom. Bulgarian rose and peony make their appearance in the heart with a touch of romantic floral flavour sprinkled with blackcurrant sweetness. Caramel and incense base is creamy, warm and a bit smoky and thus long-lasting and elegant. This perfume is feminine, self-confident, and suitable for those women who admire sweet flowers with a warm touch.

products.title: Maison Margiela Replica Tea Escape Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Maison Margiela Replica Tea Escape Eau de Toilette is a soft, calming and fresh women's perfume that feels like a peaceful tea break away from noise. The chilly mint, luminous bergamot and tiny pink pepper ignite the senses at the start. The central notes of green tea, soft jasmine and osmanthus add a subtle floral mood. At the end, you will find milk, rice and mate's warm and creamy mix, which gives the fragrance a cozy yet fresh aura. It is soft, soothing and very basic in a nice way.

products.title: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum For Her
products.body_html: Gucci Flora Eau de Parfum is a women's perfume of a floral nature. It was introduced in 2010 and is renowned for its soft, fresh, and feminine smell. The fragrance starts with peony, citrus and mandarin orange that provide a fresh and light beginning to it. The heart contains roses and osmanthus, giving a floral smoothness. Sandalwood and patchouli are used in the base to produce a warm and classy finish that remains soft on the skin.

products.title: Women Office Discovery Set - Narciso Rodriguez For Her, Prada La Femme, London By Burberry
products.body_html:
Enhance your professional elegance with our Women Office Discovery Set, featuring three exquisite fragrances:

  • Narciso Rodriguez For Her EDP: Revel in the sensual and modern floral notes, offering a sophisticated allure that's perfect for the office.
  • Prada La Femme EDP: Experience a luxurious blend of frangipani, tuberose, and vanilla, embodying grace and femininity.
  • London by Burberry EDP: Enjoy a classic and refined scent with a unique combination of rose, honeysuckle, and jasmine, ideal for making a lasting impression.

Curated for the modern professional woman, these fragrances exude confidence and elegance, making every day at the office extraordinary.

products.title: Tom Ford Vanilla Sex Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Vanilla Sex by Tom Ford is a Oriental Vanilla fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Vanilla Sex was launched in 2023. Top note is Bitter Almond; middle notes are Vanilla and Floral Notes; base notes are Vanilla Absolute, Ultravanil™, Tonka Bean and Sandalwood.

products.title: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Juicy Couture Viva La Juicy Noir perfume is a women's fragrance that is sweet, bold, and playful with a rich and glamorous feeling. It starts with juicy wild berries along with a hint of mandarin orange and the impression is of freshness and fun. The heart of the fragrance consists of gardenia, jasmine, and honeysuckle which form the base of the creamy floral smell. The end notes of caramel, vanilla, amber, and sandalwood blend together to form a warm, sweet, and smooth base that lasts for many hours. The scent is perfect for women who love sweet, flirty, and feminine fragrances but with a little depth.

products.title: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Sweet Paradise Eau de Parfum is a light and cheerful perfume targeted at women who will appreciate sweet and fresh perfumes. It has a light fruity sensation in the beginning, with the mixture of mandarin and clear musk that is very smooth. Soft flowers and peach make the heart feel creamy and soft. The foundation is cosy and sweet with tonka and heliotrope, so the smell is very soothing and permanent. Worn all the time and on special occasions.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Kohl Luminous Eau de Parfum is a fresh, sweet and modern unisex perfume from the house of Arabiyat Prestige. Launched in 2025, this fragrance feels bright and playful but also warm at the same time. It begins with rich fruits and citrus flavors, which are vibrant and vivid. As it settles, soft florals and a creamy sweetness start to show, making it smooth and pleasing. The base is warm and woody and a little sweet, making the perfume to be in balance and very comfortable.

products.title: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Nafaeis Al Shaghaf Pour Femme Eau De Parfum from Rasasi is a fragrance for women who love warm and creamy scents. The perfume is soft, sweet and elegant. The fragrance starts with a warm mix of almond, lemon and coffee that is creamy and slightly sweet. The middle turns floral with jasmine, tuberose, iris and lily, giving it a rich and feminine touch. The dry down reveals a warm and soft base consisting of vanilla, musk, sandalwood and amber, which is quite close to the skin and very satisfying. This perfume is simple, classy and easy to wear for daily use as well as special moments.

products.title: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi La Yuqawam Jasmine Wisp Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and elegant perfume made for women who love floral scents with a creamy touch. It opens fresh and juicy with citrus fruits and gradually turns into a smooth mix of jasmine, fruits and coconut. The base feels warm and comforting with vanilla and amber, making it ideal for daily wear and unique moments too. It smells classy but is still easy to wear, not heavy at all.

products.title: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Parfums de Marly Valaya Eau de Parfum is a soft, clean and elegant scent. Released in 2023, this perfume feels light yet classy with a fresh, fruity, floral style. It opens with airy aldehydes, juicy white peach, bergamot and mandarin orange. The heart brings soft florals like orange blossom, lily-of-the-valley and modern notes like Petalia and Nympheal blended with light vetiver and mahonia. The base dries down into smooth musk, creamy vanilla, ambroxan and woody akigalawood, giving it a clean and comforting finish.

products.title: Men Office Discovery Set - Montblanc Explorer, Prada L'homme, Terre D'hermes Eau Intense Vetiver
products.body_html:
Elevate your professional presence with our Men Office Discovery Set, featuring three premium fragrances:

  • Montblanc Explorer EDP: Embrace adventure with this bold, woody scent that exudes confidence and determination.
  • Prada L'Homme EDT: Experience refined elegance with a sophisticated blend of floral and amber notes, perfect for the modern gentleman.
  • Terre d'Hermes Eau Intense Vetiver EDP: Discover a fresh, earthy fragrance that combines vetiver with spicy and citrus undertones, ideal for making a lasting impression.

Perfectly curated for the modern professional, these scents embody elegance and confidence, making every day at the office exceptional.

products.title: Lattafa Mashmoom Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Mashmoom by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Mashmoom was launched in 2025. Top notes are Rose and Bergamot; middle notes are Caramel and Peony; base notes are Musk and Vanilla.

products.title: Creed Millesime Imperial Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de Parfum is a fresh, elegant, and timeless fragrance that captures the spirit of coastal luxury and warm sunshine. Created by the House of Creed in 1995, this iconic scent is loved by both men and women for its clean, citrusy freshness with a smooth musky finish.

Creed Millésime Impérial Eau de fragrance opens with a burst of juicy fruits and sea breeze, making you feel like you’re walking along a royal Mediterranean coast. As it develops, warm woods and musk add depth and sophistication, making it a perfect choice for those who want a scent that’s both refreshing and classy.

Creed Millésime Impérial is a fragrance that fits every season and every occasion. Whether it’s a sunny day, a romantic evening, or a formal event, this perfume makes you feel confident, clean, and irresistible.

products.title: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Burberry Her Eau de Parfum is a sweet, fruity and soft perfume that is designed to suit women who place a premium on modern and great style perfumes. The perfume opens with light-hearted and sweet scents of strawberry and raspberry, and cherry berry. The violet and jasmine floral notes come out to produce a feminine touch. Vanilla and musk mixed with the woody in the base notes of the fragrance are warm and smooth on the skin all day long.

products.title: Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Burberry Brit For Her Eau De Parfum is a sweet, fresh, and playful fragrance that feels like a cosy hug on a winter morning. It blends juicy fruits, soft flowers, and warm, creamy notes to create a scent that is charming yet comforting.

The fragrance opens with a burst of fresh lime, sweet pear, and a hint of almond. Soon, the heart reveals a beautiful mix of candied almond, sugar, and soft peony flowers, making it both sweet and romantic. As it dries down, warm vanilla, tonka bean, amber, and mahogany wood wrap you in a smooth, cosy finish.

Burberry Brit For Her is perfect for women who love a feminine scent that is both casual and classy. It’s the kind of perfume that makes you feel confident and beautiful without being too loud.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Girl Lady Vengeance Extreme Eau de Perrier is a strong, rich and intense chypre perfume targeting women who like aggressive scents. It is black, sexy and bold after the initial spray. The heavy patchouli is mixed with Bulgarian rose and smooth vanilla to produce a warm and slightly sweet scent. This perfume is not tender or modest; it is bold, assertive and crafted to be conspicuous.

products.title: Al Haramain L'Aventure Blanche Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: L'Aventure Blanche by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Floral fragrance for women. L'Aventure Blanche was launched in 2017. Top notes are Lemon, Bergamot, Lavender and Rose; middle notes are Black Currant, Jasmine, Orris and Lily-of-the-Valley; base notes are Sandalwood and Amber.

products.title: Bath & Body Works In the Stars Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: In The Stars by Bath & Body Works is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. In The Stars was launched in 2017.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Legere Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Good Girl Légère Eau de Parfum is a modern, bold perfume for women. Launched in 2018, it is a lighter and fresher version of the original Good Girl, balancing sweet, floral, and warm notes perfectly. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh top notes of ylang-ylang, mandarin orange, bergamot, and lemon; the heart is full of floral beauty with tuberose, jasmine, orange blossom, and Bulgarian rose. The base adds depth with dulche de leche, praline, tonka bean, cinnamon, cashmerwood, sandalwood, musk, amber, patchouli, and cedar, leaving a warm, long-lasting trail.

products.title: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Armaf Island Bliss Eau de Parfum is a fragrance that is soft, sweet, and cheerful which is made for women loving the aroma of fresh tropical fruits. The fragrance opens with wild berries and green notes which are light and playful. Eventually, it becomes creamy with the addition of coconut, orange blossom, and water lily, thus a beach-like setting is created. The dry down has vanilla, tonka bean, and musk that are close to the skin and are warm, smooth, and comforting. This perfume has a relaxing, feminine and casual vibe which is perfect for everyday use.

products.title: Le Labo Fleur d'Oranger 27 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: A soft yet strong fragrance in floral Fleur d'Oranger 27 by Le Labo is a women's and men's fragrance. It was released in 2006 and made by perfumer Francoise Caron. The smell is fresh, clean and somewhat warm concurrently. Here, the star is orange blossom, which has an unadulterated white floral fragrance, which is light yet slightly erotic.

products.title: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Lattafa Bayaan Eau de Parfum is a pleasant and luxurious women's perfume that is fruity, flowery and slightly creamy. It starts and becomes sunny and fatty, but then gradually becomes gentle and cosy to the skin. The rose, praline and vanilla blend make it very rich and smooth. It is a stylish and at the same time fun smell that will appeal to the women who enjoy sweet scents and have a bold flavour.

products.title: Women Daytime Discovery Set - Giorgio Armani Si Fiori, Ysl Libre, Giorgio Armani In Love With You
products.body_html:
Brighten your day with elegance and charm with our Women Daytime Discovery Set, featuring three delightful fragrances:

  • Giorgio Armani Si Fiori EDP: Embrace the delicate blend of floral and citrus notes, creating a fresh and radiant scent that’s perfect for daytime wear.
  • YSL Libre EDP: Experience the bold fusion of lavender essence and orange blossom, offering a powerful and sophisticated fragrance for the confident woman.
  • Giorgio Armani In Love With You EDP: Enjoy the modern and captivating scent of fruity and floral notes, embodying youthful energy and passion.

Curated for the modern woman, these fragrances are perfect for enhancing your daytime presence.

products.title: Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Rose Prick Eau de Parfum is a daring and luxurious rose scent that is rich, spicy, and floral simultaneously. The perfume starts with a pungent blend of Sichuan pepper and turmeric, which is warm and mildly spicy. The heart, by and by, unfolds strong, deep, and at the same time fresher and from time to time romantic rose notes. The patchouli and tonka bean base gives the fragrance both profoundness and silky texture. This fragrance is self-assured, contemporary, and unisex, thus ideal for those who love roses.

products.title: Chloe Nomade Nuit d'Egypte Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Chloe Nomade Nuit d’Egypte Eau de Parfum is a elegant perfume for women. It was launched in 2024 it is an oriental floral fragrance that combines spicy, floral and warm notes into a smooth and captivating scent. It start with myrrh, cinnamon and ginger followed by the middle notes of orange blossom, Kyphi and broom and settles on a warm base of vanilla, opoponax and cypriol oil. This fragrance is perfect for evening wear and special occasions offering a adventurous aura.

products.title: Bath & Body Works At The Beach Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: At the Beach by Bath & Body Works is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women and men. At the Beach was launched in 2017.

products.title: Bath & Body Works A Thousand Wishes Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: A Thousand Wishes by Bath & Body Works is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women. A Thousand Wishes was launched in 2020.

products.title: Juliette Has A Gun Miss Charming Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Juliette Has A Gun Miss Charming Eau de Parfum is a fruity floral fragrance for women. Miss Charming was launched in 2006. The nose behind this fragrance is Francis Kurkdjian. It opens with fresh Moroccan rose that smells soft and romantic. After some time, wild strawberry adds a light, juicy sweetness that feels playful and feminine. The base is made of smooth musk, which stays close to the skin and gives a clean finish. It is a delicate, charming perfume, perfect for daily wear and warm days.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Fleur Narcotique Extrait de Parfum begins with a sunny and juicy combination of litchi and bergamot that is smooth and bright. After a certain period, there are soft floral tones of peony, freesia, orange blossom, and jasmine emerging and rendering the smell graceful and creamy. The foundation of musk, sandalwood and moss provides a fresh and clean woody feel that lasts many hours on the skin. This perfume is fresh, floral, and a bit sensual, which is ideal for those who like soft yet powerful luxury fragrances.

products.title: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum by Versace is a Floral Woody Musk fragrance for women. Versace Eros Pour Femme Eau de Parfum was launched in 2014. The fragrance opens with bright and fresh notes of Sicilian lemon, pomegranate and Calabrian bergamot, which feel juicy and energetic. The heart brings a soft floral mix of lemon blossom, jasmine sambac, jasmine and peony. In the base, sandalwood, musk, ambroxan and woody notes create a warm, smooth and long-lasting finish that feels elegant and feminine.

products.title: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ard Al Zaafaran Mousuf Eau de Parfum is a sweet and warm, but a little bit dark, fragrance created for women who are fond of heavy scents, The fragrance opens up with a delicious and soft mixture of grapes and chocolate that is very inviting. It calms down and the warmth and depth of the oud and musk are felt. In the end, toffee, tobacco, and delicate florals linger on the skin for hours. This perfume gives the impression of being sweet, soft, and very addictive.

products.title: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rasasi Entebaa Eau de Parfum is a bold and warm oriental fragrance made for men who like strong and sweet scents. It opens with a fruity and spicy mix that feels rich and energetic. Then, the wood and earth notes take over, creating an atmosphere of depth and masculinity. The final notes are a mixture of creaminess, sweetness and slight hints of gourmand, making Rasasi Entebaa a perfume that is very much alive and noticeable for a long period.

products.title: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Franck Boclet Cocaine Eau De Parfum is an enticingly intense, blistering scent. It has that rich, sweet, luxurious feeling. It opens up with caramel, red berries, bitter orange, and tobacco; and feels creamy, smokey, and somehow fruity. The heart has tuberose, orchid, and lily, which creates a soft, weighty floral accord. In the base, monoi oil, vanilla, and patchouli develop warm, deep qualities. It has a definite presence, is fun yet very classy. There is sweet quality here, but also an earthy balance. It is a great fragrance for anyone into heavier, richer fragrances that last.

products.title: Chopard Jasmin Moghol Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Chopard Jasmin Moghol EDP is a luxurious fragrance for men and women. It opens with the soft, fresh scent of Chinese Jasmine that feels pure and uplifting. The middle notes combine Bulgarian Rose and Turkish Rose to give a romantic, flowery touch. Sandalwood in the base adds warmth and depth, making it perfect for evening wear. 

This perfume was created by Alberto Morillas in 2018, it is loved by fragrance lovers for its smooth floral aroma and balanced, long-lasting scent.

products.title: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Cartier Baiser Vole Eau De Parfum is a delicate floral perfume made for women. It opens with fresh and sparkling notes of lily and citrus, which gives a soft and elegant feel. The heart is pure lily, keeping the floral theme alive, while the base is green lily and fresh green notes that make the perfume natural, light, and refreshing. It is perfect for women who like soft, floral, and graceful scents that feel fresh all day.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Very Good Girl Eau de Parfum is a lively and charming fragrance for women. Launched in 2021, it has a playful and bold scent profile made from fresh, fruity, and floral notes. The top notes of litchi and red currant give it a sweet and juicy start, the heart of rose adds a delicate floral touch, and the base of vanilla and vetiver gives a warm and elegant finish. Very Good Girl is perfect for confident women who want a mix of fun and sophistication in one fragrance.

products.title: Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Amouage Lustre Eau de Parfum is a radiant and sophisticated unisex fragrance that feels like liquid sunshine on the skin. A modern masterpiece from the House of Amouage, this scent is designed to evoke a sense of pure elegance and a radiant aura. It beautifully balances warm spices, soft florals, and creamy woods to create a fragrance that is both comforting and captivating.

Amouage Lustre smells incredibly luxurious yet is easy to wear. It has a rich depth and a warm glow that makes you feel special and confident. It’s the perfect choice for those who love modern, elegant fragrances that leave a lasting, memorable impression. One spray of Amouage Lustre will wrap you in a golden embrace, making you feel polished and effortlessly chic.

products.title: Al Haramain Musk Attar Roll On
products.body_html: Musk by Al Haramain Perfumes is a Oriental Floral fragrance for women.

products.title: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Carolina Herrera Vetiver Paradise Eau de Parfum is a unisex perfume with a fresh, woody, and spicy character. Launched in 2017, it combines bright citrus, warm spices, and earthy woody notes into a smooth and elegant composition. The perfume opens with fresh top notes of bergamot, grapefruit, and pink pepper, moves into a spicy and floral heart of neroli, nutmeg, and cardamom, and finally settles into a grounding base of vetiver and woody notes. It is a versatile scent perfect for daily wear or special occasions.

products.title: Louis Vuitton eLves Eau de Parfum
products.body_html:
Louis Vuitton eLVes Eau de Perrier is a warm and classy perfume for women with a fruity floral flavour. It starts with voluptuous peach and black currant, blended with the light spice of ginger and cinnamon. It is light and pleasant to begin with, without being too powerful.


Rose mixes with the coconut milk and gentle florals in the heart, making it creamy and feminine. Ambroxan and patchouli are warm, slightly woody, and long-lasting due to the base of the product. This smell is elegant, proud and befits a woman who enjoys expensive but at the same time expensive perfumes.

products.title: Victoria's Secret Sliver Of Sun Body Mist
products.body_html: Sliver Of Sun by Victoria's Secret is a Floral fragrance for women. Sliver Of Sun was launched in 2021.

products.title: Le Labo Lys 41 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Le Labo Lys 41 Eau de Parfum is a white and cream floral perfume that is oriented to women who are fond of white flowers. It is warm, sunny, and sweet, to some extent. The fragrance opens with jasmine and lily softness, giving the perfume a very rich floral touch, and changes gradually more creamy with vanilla and white musk. It is smelly, posh, silky and highly feminine. This perfume suits an individual who prefers perfumes of classy, floral fragrances that remain pleasant enough to be noticed and beautiful.

products.title: Killian Rolling in Love Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rolling in Love by By Kilian is a women's and men's Oriental Floral fragrance. Rolling in Love was released in 2019. The nose of this perfume is Pascal Gaurin. The top notes are Almond Milk and Ambrette (Musk Mallow); middle notes are Iris, Freesia, Heliotrope, Raspberry, Hedione, and Peony; and the bottom note is Vanilla, Tuberose, Tonka Bean, Musk, Lactones and Caramel.

products.title: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Meringue Eau de Parfum is a soft, creamy and modern women’s perfume for those who love sweet but balanced scents. It opens fresh and juicy with pineapple, mandarin and bergamot that feel bright and happy. Slowly, it turns smooth and cozy with suede and sandalwood at its middle notes. The base is warm and comforting with vanilla, white musk, birch and ambergris, giving it a clean yet slightly woody finish.

products.title: Bath & Body Works Pink Cashmere Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: Pink Cashmere by Bath & Body Works is a Floral fragrance for women. Pink Cashmere was launched in 2020.

products.title: Bath & Body Works Japanese Cherry Blossom Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: Japanese Cherry Blossom by Bath & Body Works is a Floral Fruity fragrance for women. Japanese Cherry Blossom was launched in 2021.

products.title: Bath & Body Works Coco Paradise Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: Coco Paradise by Bath & Body Works is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. Coco Paradise was launched in 2023.

products.title: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: French Avenue Giovanni Lorenzi Tesoro Eau de Parfum is a bold, rich perfume for men who like strong, classy scents. It has a warm, amber and leather feel and a sweet and spicy touch. This men’s perfume is inspired by 1 Million Parfum by Paco Rabanne, but it still has its own strong character. It is fresh and juicy on the opening, spicy and floral in the middle and deep, warm and slightly smoky on the base.

products.title: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Ex Nihilo Viper Green Eau de Parfum is a truly confident and lively fragrance – it’s a natural scent. Viper Green is elegant and fully audacious at the same time and is a great fit for a person who likes the cool contrast of feeling fresh but warm at the same time. The scent has that luxury clean aspect, but that unique green bite, distinguishes it from the other standard citrus or floral fragrances out there. That specific citrus in woods helps Viper Green enact a niche in greater appeal with people who desire sophistication, but also differentiate it from traditional fragrance to one that exhibits an edge.

products.title: Yves Saint Laurent L'Homme Eau de Toilette
products.body_html: Yves Saint Laurent L’Homme Eau de Toilette is a light and fresh male perfume that is spicy and mild. It is sublime and clean yet also homely and masculine. The introduction begins with oranges and ginger that provide a refreshing effect. Then, soft spices and violet leaf arrive after a long while, which gives a smooth aspect. During the dry down, tonka bean, cedar and vetiver form a warm woody base, which remains softly pinned on the skin.

products.title: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Tom Ford Soleil Neige Eau de Parfum is a light and mellow floral woody musk perfume for women and men. At the same time, it is clean, bright and a bit creamy. The onset is gentle citrus bergamot and light carrot seed note, which is airy. Then there come jasmine, white flowers and roses gradually, and make it elegant. The vanilla and benzoin base offer a warm and soft finish, which remains well on the skin.

products.title: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Ribelle Eau De Parfum
products.body_html: Salvatore Ferragamo Signorina Ribelle Eau De Parfum is a bold, sweet and modern fragrance made for confident women. A top note of the fragrance is a lively combination of pink pepper and sweet mandarin, which is very fresh and even fun-like. This is followed by a moderate flowery mixing of frangipani and ylang-ylang that gives the perfume a rich and lovely aspect. The base note is what really steals the show as it features a mixture of nice ice cream, coconut milk and vanilla, making the perfume warm, smooth and slightly addictive.

products.title: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Stella & Luna Extrait de Parfum is a rich and sweet fragrance made for women who love warm and creamy scents. The opening feels nutty and smooth with black currant, hazelnut, milk and praline, giving a soft gourmand touch. In the heart, rose, jasmine, and iris add a floral beauty, while cacao brings a slight chocolate feel. The base is deep and warm with vanilla, honey, musk and sandalwood that stays on skin for long hours. It feels elegant, cozy and a little addictive.

products.title: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Rose 1969 Eau de Parfum is a modern unisex perfume. Launched in 2024, this scent offers a creamy, floral and warm spicy style that feels classy yet bold. It opens with a lively mix of black pepper and juicy lychee, offering a fresh, spicy sweet start. The heart blooms with soft damask rose and warm amber, giving a smooth floral warmth. The base note of patchouli adds depth and a slightly earthy touch that blends nicely and stays long on skin.

products.title: Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum is a new unisex perfume. It is a smooth, floral, fruity scent made with creamy coconut in the opening, white florals in the middle and soft sandalwood in the dry down. Rabanne Midnight Sex Eau de Parfum feels warm, slightly sweet and a little sensual, but still clean and elegant.

products.title: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Paco Rabanne Lady Million Eau de Parfum is an exquisite combination of sweetness, class, and confidence, which is the perfect fit for women who desire to be in the limelight. The fragrance starts with a mixture of delicious raspberry and sparkling lemon that is so fresh and cheerful. Then the gentle white flowers such as jasmine and orange blossom appear and add a rich, feminine note. The honey and patchouli support the fragrance as warm, soft, and very enduring on the skin. The scent is sophisticated, daring, and very attractive.

products.title: Lattafa Esraa Attar Perfume Oil
products.body_html: Attar Esraa by Lattafa Perfumes is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. This is a new fragrance. Attar Esraa was launched in 2025. Top notes are Blackcurrant, Lychee and Apple; middle notes are Rose, Red Fruits and Raspberry; base notes are Musk, Caramel and Vanilla.

products.title: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme
products.body_html: Gucci Guilty Elixir de Parfum Pour Femme is the perfume that you might love if you are into stylish perfumes. The fragrance starts with gentle violet, mandora, and a hint of fresh bergamot. The middle notes are creamy with wisteria, rose, and osmanthus. The base notes are soft and smooth with tonka bean, vanilla, and patchouli. This is a daring and comforting perfume designed for women who enjoy sweet, creamy florals along with a little warmth for evening and cooler weather.

products.title: Giorgio Armani In Love With You Eau De Parfum
products.body_html:
Giorgio Armani In Love With You EDP for women is a sweet, romantic scent that perfectly captures the feeling of falling head over heels. The fragrance opens with juicy, bright notes of raspberry, black currant, and sour cherry. It then blooms into a heart of rose, jasmine, and wormwood. It finally settles into a warm, grounded patchouli base. Launched in 2019, this perfume captures the rush of love, mixing gentle fruits and strong flowers, creating a vibe that is both fragile yet passionately strong. 


Fragrance lovers often call it an addictive, girly treat, describing it as the perfect date night magic with good staying power. It leaves a soft, sweet trail that people notice, often resulting in compliments all evening. Wearing it makes you feel pretty and confident, like you are wrapped in a cozy, lingering berry hug that is noticeable without being overwhelming.

products.title: Creed Royal Princes Oud Eau de Parfum (2024)
products.body_html: Creed Royal Princess Oud Eau de Parfum is a gentle, luxurious fragrance that is created by women who desire to represent royalty. The perfume opens in a light, flowery, fresh and blends violet, rose and bergamot to give the light, smooth fragrance. The aroma becomes a warm, creamy smell that has jasmine, iris, patchouli and a faint quantity of vanilla sweetness. The smell of the perfume is oud mixed with sandalwood and styrax, that give it a woody aroma that stays several hours on the body of the person. There is a class,y feminine smell in the perfume that is luxurious.

products.title: Bath & Body Works You're the One Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: You're The One by Bath & Body Works is a Floral fragrance for women. You're The One was launched in 2020.

products.title: Bath & Body Works If you Musk Fine Fragrance Mist
products.body_html: If You Musk by Bath & Body Works is a Floral fragrance for women. This is a new fragrance. If You Musk was launched in 2024.

products.title: Arabiyat Prestige Luthfah First Love Eau de Parfum
products.body_html: Arabiyat Prestige Luthfaf First Love Eau de Parfum is a soft, sweet and romantic fragrance made for women who love gentle yet addictive scents. It opens with a fresh fruity touch of lemon, peach and cassis mixed with green cypress, giving a bright and cheerful start. The heart is floral and creamy with jasmine, ylang ylang, violet and milky lactones that feel smooth and comforting. As it settles, it becomes warm and cozy with vanilla, caramel, heliotrope and musk. The base feels sweet, powdery and slightly creamy, perfect for daily wear and special moments.

products.title: Jo Malone Nectarine Blossom & Honey Body & Hand Wash
products.body_html: Nectarine Blossom & Honey by Jo Malone London is a Floral Fruity Gourmand fragrance for women and men. Nectarine Blossom & Honey was launched in 2005. The nose behind this fragrance is Jo Malone. Top notes are Green Notes, Black Currant and Petitgrain; middle notes are Nectarine and Black locust; base notes are Peach, Plum and Vetiver.

products.title: Elie Saab Girl of Now Shower Gel
products.body_html: Bathe your skin in this rich shower gel scented with Elie Saab's Girl Of Now fragrance. Skin feels cleansed and revitalised with a delicate floral scent.

products.title: Diptyque  Pommade Smoothing Body Polish
products.body_html:
This velvety body polish with exfoliating grains delivers all the benevolence of the pomegranate, queen of fruits.
Perfumed with Arabian jasmine, pink peppercorn and peach, this rich, creamy-textured care product combines the fine qualities of pomegranate oil, jasmine floral water and peach butter.

products.title: Diptyque  Eau Rose Shower Foam
products.body_html: An indulgence. Upon contact with water, Eau Rose shower foam is transformed, becoming as velvety as whipped cream. The transparent gel evokes an infusion of roses, combining floral damascena notes with fruity accents of litchi. Softens and scents the skin.

products.title: Dior Gris Hand & Body Soap
products.body_html: Gris Dior by Dior is a Floral fragrance for women and men. Gris Dior was launched in 2017. The nose behind this fragrance is François Demachy.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Ruby Extrait de Parfum is a women's perfume that is warm and elegant, and it is sweet, flowery, and slightly spicy. It opens bright with bergamot, orange and blackcurrant combined with sweet notes and saffron to give it a good first impression. It is smooth and feminine, and as if out of nothing, slow and soft jasmine and violet emerge. The foundation of musk, amber, cashmeran, and moss remains long-lasting on the skin and is comfortable, deep, and luxurious for hours.

products.title: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum
products.body_html: Riiffs Samah Onyx Extrait de Parfum is a sweet, creamy and warm perfume that is designed to be used by men and women alike. It begins with gentle vanilla orchid and ylang ylang that is blended in with the touch of whipped cream that is rich and comforting. The heart is serving rose and peony with a small twist of fruity blackcurrant. Caramel, woods and incense render it deep in the dry down, sweet and to a certain extent smoky. It is classy, welcoming and highly enjoyable.
